Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Identify and measure success of International Product Growth & Insights initiatives through goal setting, forecasting, and monitoring of key product and growth metrics
Analyze international user behavior and market trends to uncover growth opportunities and inform product strategy across global markets
Partner with International Marketing teams to measure campaign effectiveness, optimize targeting strategies, and drive user acquisition in key regions
Work with large and complex data sets to solve challenging problems using analytical and statistical approaches, translating findings into actionable growth recommendations
Collaborate with cross-functional partners including engineering, product, and regional teams to inform and execute international growth strategies
Conduct exploratory analysis to discover new market opportunities, understand regional trends, and identify levers to accelerate international growth

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience in analytics, or 4+ years of experience in analytics with a Master's degree
Experience working with and influencing multidisciplinary teams
Experience with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), A/B testing, and basic statistics knowledge
Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, making decisions with incomplete information
Experience in improving data collection work, data processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis
Capacity to work with teams based outside of North America across multiple time zones


Preferred Qualifications:


Fluent in multiple languages to support product analysis and stakeholder communication across international markets
Experience with GTM or Product Marketing Managers
Experience in international growth

Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success:


Runner First
We act in the best interest of the runner
Word is Bond
We do what we say we’ll do
Champion Heart
We give our all in everything we do
There is no “I” in Run
We stay generous with our humanity
Keep Moving
We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!

We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.

Your Job: As the Retail Business Analyst at Brooks, you will play a critical role in driving performance across Brooks’ branded retail fleet by delivering data-driven insights that inform decision-making across store operations, merchandising, and customer experience. You will support Retail Operations, Store Leadership, and crossfunctional partners by analyzing business performance across multiple locations, identifying opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve sales, inventory productivity, and operational effectiveness. You have a combined passion for retail, analytics, and the Brooks brand, with a strong ability to influence through data storytelling and business partnership.

Your Responsibilities

Business Performance & Reporting


Analyze store and fleet-level performance across key KPIs including sales, conversion, traffic, average transaction value (ATV), and units per transaction (UPT).
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that provide visibility into daily, weekly, and seasonal performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities across stores, regions, and product categories.
Partner with Retail leadership to deliver clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making.


Merchandising & Inventory Insights


Evaluate product performance across footwear, apparel, and accessories to inform assortment and allocation decisions.
Analyze size curves, sell-through, and inventory levels to recommend replenishment and depth strategies.
Support inventory optimization efforts to minimize markdown risk and maximize in-stock availability.
Partner with Merchandising and Planning teams on seasonal strategies and performance reviews.


Store Operations & Productivity


Provide analytics that support labor optimization, store productivity, and operational efficiency.
Analyze store processes and customer flow to identify opportunities to enhance the in-store experience.
Support new store openings with forecasting, benchmarking, and performance tracking.
Identify and scale best practices across the retail fleet.


Customer & Omnichannel Insights


Analyze customer behavior and purchase patterns across in-store and digital touchpoints.
Support initiatives that connect retail and eCommerce experiences (e.g., omnichannel capabilities).
Partner with Marketing and CRM teams to evaluate campaign performance and customer engagement in retail.
Identify opportunities to improve customer retention and lifetime value.


Strategic Projects & Cross-Functional Partnership


Support strategic initiatives including retail expansion, store format evolution, and performance segmentation.
Conduct ad hoc analysis for leadership to support business priorities and decision-making.
Partner cross-functionally with Retail, Finance, Marketing, Planning, and Product teams to ensure alignment.
Contribute to annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; equivalent combination of education and years of experience can be considered in lieu of degree(s)
5+ years of experience in retail analytics, business analysis, or a related field, preferably at a specialty retail, athletic/footwear, or branded retail environment
Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (i.e., Power BI, Tableau, or similar); experience with SQL or data query tools a plus
Experience working with POS systems, traffic data, and inventory management platforms
Familiarity with omnichannel retail models
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating effective listening through concise, clear verbal and written communication
Excellent interpersonal skills that inspire and build trust resulting in effective working relationships across the company
Keen attention to detail in planning, organization, and execution of tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how all the pieces fit together and affect one another
Ability to anticipate how a decision made can affect our customers, our partners, our products, or other departments’ operations and/or morale; “connecting the dots”
Demonstration of innovation and initiative – always looking at improving our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary
Passionate participation in Brooks’ sports activities a plus, overridden by the ability to understand and empathize with the runner to develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community
Embraces and lives the Brooks values!


Compensation: The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $91,931 - $137,896 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Other

Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families!

Benefits- including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family & fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance.

Paid Time Off- Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave.

Bonus- in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance.

Perks- including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits.

Location- You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem-solving, and celebrations happen in person.

At Brooks, we celebrate diversity & equity. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and encourage people of all backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and skills to apply. Brooks is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, two-spirit identity, sexual orientation, genetic information, the presence of a physical, mental, or sensory disability, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related conditions), caste, citizenship or immigration status, honorably discharged veteran or military status, actual or perceived victims of domestic violence, harassment, sexual assault or stalking, HIV or Hepatitis C infection, political ideology, use of a trained service animal by a person with a disability, or on any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law, or any other non-merit based factors.

Title: TikTok Shop - Strategy & Data Analyst, E-Commerce
Description:
Responsibilities
About The Team:
The E-commerce Strategy team for TikTok Shop plays a critical role in setting direction and accelerating growth of the US market. The team operates at the center of global strategy planning, research and analysis, partnering closely with regional and industry leaders to identify market opportunity, determine operation directions and set key team targets. We are looking for a Strategy & Analytics Associate for Business Analytics team.

Responsibilities:
- Develop short-term and long-term scale and revenue targets for our Global E-commerce business, focusing on establishing a metric system, setting business goals, and developing performance tracking mechanisms.
- Leverage insights from analysis to provide informed recommendations for future business strategy.
- Conduct thorough market segmentation research and track industry trends to identify potential business opportunities.
- Familiarity with E-commerce business logic and analytical frameworks, possessing the ability to think structurally, provide data-driven insights, identify key factors, simplify complex issues, align thinking with business objectives.
- Identify problems and business pain points (focusing on merchant growth, traffic efficiency/conversion, and user behavior) to help the business increase revenue.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above, with 5+ years of work experience.
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL/Python.
- Experience in strategic consulting and analysis.
- Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, excellent logical thinking, and data sensitivity.
- Ability to quickly grasp business contexts and identify key business drivers behind data.

Preferred Qualification:
- Experience in operations analysis, business analysis, and data analysis in the e-commerce industry is strongly preferred.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​


Job Information

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $115520 - $198360 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Title: Business Analyst, Integrated Demand Center, AWS Marketing, IDC Analytics
Description:
Description

The IDC Analytics team is looking for a strong, analytically minded Business Analyst to own end-to-end analytics that drive AWS Marketing’s demand generation strategy. In this role, you will design measurement frameworks, develop reports and dashboards, and deliver actionable insights that directly influence campaign investment decisions and pipeline outcomes. You will serve as the connective tissue between marketing stakeholders and technical teams - translating complex business questions into structured analytical plans, building scalable reporting solutions, and ensuring that the right data reaches the right decision-makers at the right time. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently, thrives on solving ambiguous analytical problems, and brings a passion for using data to drive marketing effectiveness at scale.

Key job responsibilities


Own the design and delivery of analytics for one or more marketing workstreams (e.g., campaign measurement, channels analytics, pipeline attribution, or lead scoring)
Build and maintain dashboards and automated reports in QuickSight, providing self-serve visibility to marketing partners
Write complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale marketing datasets
Partner with marketing program managers and channel owners to translate business questions into structured analytical plans
Author and own Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) that bridge the gap between marketers and technical teams — working with D:SE (Data Science & Engineering) and S&O (Strategy & Operations) to build and enhance performance dashboards
Leverage AI tools (such as Kiro IDE, Amazon Quick, and MCP integrations) to accelerate analytical workflows, automate repetitive reporting, and enhance data exploration
Build AI-powered automations and lightweight applications for data validation, report generation acceleration, and A/B testing model development
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities in campaign performance data; proactively surface insights to stakeholders
Contribute to ETL pipeline development and data quality initiatives using tools like Alchemy
Document methodologies and socialize findings through written narratives (6-pagers, flash reports)


A day in the life

Your main focus is turning marketing data into clear answers. Most mornings, you’ll check dashboards to see how campaigns perform, dig into anomalies, and share findings with the marketers running those campaigns before they even ask. You’ll write SQL against large datasets to deep dive and do root cause analysis - connecting top of funnel metrics to revenue impact. You’ll partner with teams to translate their questions into structured analytical plans, and use AI tools to automate reporting, validate data, and speed up your workflows. When something interesting surfaces, you won’t wait to be asked - you’ll bring it to the table.

About The Team

The Integrated Demand Center (IDC) is AWS Marketing’s unified function for planning, delivering, and measuring demand generation at scale. The IDC Analytics team sits within Demand Services, the shared services arm powering campaign execution and innovation. We generate actionable insights across the IDC — delivering analytics, custom reporting, and clear recommendations that help teams optimize performance, strengthen adoption, and accelerate revenue impact. Our work spans configuring dashboards, defining and monitoring delivery KPIs, translating business requirements into technical specifications, supporting steering reviews and QBRs, and partnering with marketers to transform complex data into data-driven decisions at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent
5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience in writing complex, highly-optimized SQL queries across large datasets
Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools (coding assistants, AI IDEs, LLM-based agents) to generate analytical outputs and improve productivity


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with industry tools including Salesforce, Marketo, and online analytics packages
Experience building data pipelines or automated ETL processes
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
Experience in B2B marketing analytics, demand generation, or SaaS/cloud industry
Experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), or Customer Journey Analytics (CJA)
Experience building AI automation or apps that streamline data validation, reduce report generation turnaround times, or enable self-serve A/B testing

Title: Senior Product Analyst – Personal Auto Insurance
Description:
Description

Exciting Opportunity: Auto Product Analyst – Drive Innovation and Impact Across Key States!

The Auto State Management team seeks to achieve our combined ratio while growing faster than the industry growth rate. We accomplish these goals by engaging with the rest of the organization in setting the customer price level within the state, launching new pricing programs and product features, root cause analysis on issues impacting profitability or growth, and partnering with our distribution organization on how to more effectively sell our Direct and Agency products. Join our dynamic team where your analytical skills and strategic insights will directly influence product performance and business success across multiple states! In this role, you’ll tackle moderate to high complexity challenges, lead impactful projects, and collaborate with diverse teams to shape the future of our Auto products.


This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. The level of position offered will be based on skills and experience at manager discretion. **


What You’ll Do


Dive deep into data analysis to uncover trends, performance insights, and opportunities for growth in assigned states.
Be the go-to expert for state-specific auto product strategy, delivering actionable recommendations that improve pricing, training, and overall product offerings.
Lead and drive your own projects, managing work streams that have meaningful business impact.
Collaborate closely with state teams, DSOs, IT partners, and product managers to align strategies and implement nationwide initiatives.
Stay ahead of the competition by researching market dynamics, competitor filings, and customer needs to inform innovative product changes.
Share your expertise by mentoring junior analysts, developing training materials, and leading sessions that empower your colleagues.


Why You’ll Love This Role


Make a difference: Your insights will help shape personal auto insurance products that millions of customers rely on.
Lead with impact: Take ownership of projects that influence business decisions at the state and national levels
Grow your skills: Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning and development.
Be recognized: Your expertise and leadership will be valued and rewarded as you contribute to complex, strategic initiatives.


If you’re ready to challenge yourself and play a key role in transforming auto insurance products, we want to hear from you! Join us and accelerate your career while helping us deliver smarter, more competitive solutions for our customers.

Responsibilities


Conducts moderate to high complexity analysis under general direction.
As subject matter expert for assigned states, completes state reviews and similar work for basic states independently and for complex states or countrywide programs under general direction.
Queries data to conduct ad hoc analysis of metrics and builds simple tools and queries for others to use.
Provides recommendations to training and processes to manager.
Provides complex analysis to help drive and support business decisions.
Provides thoughtful recommendations to state teams on pricing, strategy, etc.
Consults on complex business issues and design considerations.
Educates IT partners on business vision and plan, and both IT and business partners on the impact of changes.
Serves as point person for moderate to high complexity country wide implementations.
Leads own work streams on medium to long-term or moderate to high complexity projects. May manage aspects of low to moderate complexity projects.
Based on strong understanding of how competitor actions impact marketplace, distribution channel and customers, conducts in depth research of competitor filings utilizing various sources. Research may be at the state, competitor or countrywide level.
Through research, identifies and proposes changes to our product offerings.
Analyzes trends and is responsible for tactical and strategic recommendations.
May create and/or be owner of training material content.
May create formal training sessions and modules.
Actively shares job knowledge with less experienced analysts.
Leads job shadow discussions with less experienced analysts.
Provides technical training and user support to business groups.
May be assigned to mentor a new hire.
May supervise interns.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or other quantitative field. Minimum 3 years, typically 4 years or more of relevant work experience.
Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis software (e.g., SAS, Access).
Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, decision making and communication skills.


About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling, or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success:


Runner First
We act in the best interest of the runner
Word is Bond
We do what we say we’ll do
Champion Heart
We give our all in everything we do
There is no “I” in Run
We stay generous with our humanity
Keep Moving
We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!


We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement - because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.

Your Job

As the Retail Business Analyst at Brooks, you will play a critical role in driving performance across Brooks’ branded retail fleet by delivering data-driven insights that inform decision-making across store operations, merchandising, and customer experience. You will support Retail Operations, Store Leadership, and crossfunctional partners by analyzing business performance across multiple locations, identifying opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that improve sales, inventory productivity, and operational effectiveness. You have a combined passion for retail, analytics, and the Brooks brand, with a strong ability to influence through data storytelling and business partnership.

Your Responsibilities

Business Performance & Reporting


Analyze store and fleet-level performance across key KPIs including sales, conversion, traffic, average transaction value (ATV), and units per transaction (UPT).
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports that provide visibility into daily, weekly, and seasonal performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities across stores, regions, and product categories.
Partner with Retail leadership to deliver clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making.


Merchandising & Inventory Insights


Evaluate product performance across footwear, apparel, and accessories to inform assortment and allocation decisions.
Analyze size curves, sell-through, and inventory levels to recommend replenishment and depth strategies.
Support inventory optimization efforts to minimize markdown risk and maximize in-stock availability.
Partner with Merchandising and Planning teams on seasonal strategies and performance reviews.


Store Operations & Productivity


Provide analytics that support labor optimization, store productivity, and operational efficiency.
Analyze store processes and customer flow to identify opportunities to enhance the in-store experience.
Support new store openings with forecasting, benchmarking, and performance tracking.
Identify and scale best practices across the retail fleet.


Customer & Omnichannel Insights


Analyze customer behavior and purchase patterns across in-store and digital touchpoints.
Support initiatives that connect retail and eCommerce experiences (e.g., omnichannel capabilities).
Partner with Marketing and CRM teams to evaluate campaign performance and customer engagement in retail.
Identify opportunities to improve customer retention and lifetime value.


Strategic Projects & Cross-Functional Partnership


Support strategic initiatives including retail expansion, store format evolution, and performance segmentation.
Conduct ad hoc analysis for leadership to support business priorities and decision-making.
Partner cross-functionally with Retail, Finance, Marketing, Planning, and Product teams to ensure alignment.
Contribute to annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; equivalent combination of education and years of experience can be considered in lieu of degree(s)
5+ years of experience in retail analytics, business analysis, or a related field, preferably at a specialty retail, athletic/footwear, or branded retail environment
Strong proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (i.e., Power BI, Tableau, or similar); experience with SQL or data query tools a plus
Experience working with POS systems, traffic data, and inventory management platforms
Familiarity with omnichannel retail models
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating effective listening through concise, clear verbal and written communication
Excellent interpersonal skills that inspire and build trust resulting in effective working relationships across the company
Keen attention to detail in planning, organization, and execution of tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how all the pieces fit together and affect one another
Ability to anticipate how a decision made can affect our customers, our partners, our products, or other departments’ operations and/or morale; “connecting the dots”
Demonstration of innovation and initiative – always looking at improving our products and processes while also displaying a willingness to dive into the details and help wherever necessary
Passionate participation in Brooks’ sports activities a plus, overridden by the ability to understand and empathize with the runner to develop loyal, engaging relationships with our customers and the Brooks community
Embraces and lives the Brooks values!


Compensation: The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $91,931 - $137,896 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Other

Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families!

Benefits - including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family & fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance.

Paid Time Off - Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave.

Bonus - in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance.

Perks - including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits.

Location - You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem-solving, and celebrations happen in person.

At Brooks, we celebrate diversity & equity. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment, and encourage people of all backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and skills to apply. Brooks is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, two-spirit identity, sexual orientation, genetic information, the presence of a physical, mental, or sensory disability, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related conditions), caste, citizenship or immigration status, honorably discharged veteran or military status, actual or perceived victims of domestic violence, harassment, sexual assault or stalking, HIV or Hepatitis C infection, political ideology, use of a trained service animal by a person with a disability, or on any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law, or any other non-merit based factors.

Title: Programmer Analyst II
Description:
Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston offices. Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo and Lewiston offices or who are willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia's dedicated team of Programmer Analysts is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Operations Business Intelligence team, our Programmer Analyst II designs, develops, and delivers data-driven programming solutions that power smarter decisions across the organization — all in service of creating an economically sustainable health care system.

Do you thrive on solving complex analytical problems with creativity and curiosity? Are you energized by translating business needs into elegant technical solutions and mentoring others along the way? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Operational Technology Management, Computer Science, Operations Research, or an equivalent related field, plus 7+ years of job-related work experience, including 2+ years in healthcare and healthcare business processes — or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience


Skills And Attributes


Demonstrated proficiency in SQL coding (Toad, DBeaver, Snowflake, etc.), ETL tools (Talend, DBT, etc.), and reporting tools (Tableau, Sigma, etc.)
Familiarity with relational databases and client-server concepts
Proven ability to perform complex analytical tasks with minimal supervision and manage large-risk, complex projects independently
Strong understanding of software testing principles and the full development lifecycle, including coding, testing, and debugging
Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into clear design specifications and technical documentation
Skill in negotiating solutions and building consensus among stakeholders with competing Business Intelligence needs
Advanced knowledge of program evaluation concepts, including effectiveness analysis, measurement, and reporting
Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making in professional settings highly desired
Solid oral and written communication skills, including presentation and technical writing
Knowledge of healthcare and healthcare business processes a plus


What You Will Do At Cambia


Design, develop, and maintain reports, programs, and analytical models that meet the needs of business partners across Cambia Health Solutions
Write clean, well-documented code and configuration using approved technologies to implement business requirements
Develop and execute tests to validate accurate implementation of business requirements
Actively manage a Local Analytic Workspace (LAW) or Collaborative Workspace (CLAW) to support Health Plan Operations' analytic and reporting needs
Proactively identify issues, communicate concerns to management, and apply knowledge of cross-departmental operations to drive effective solutions
Participate in peer review processes and contribute to a culture of quality and continuous improvement
Mentor and assist team members and internal business partners to build collective capability


Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure/certifications; and performance history.

Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $92,650-125,350, the full salary range is $87,000-142,000 and the bonus target is 15%.

North Dakota: The full salary range is $90,435-149,219.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can


Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.


We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:


Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
Commute and parking benefits.


Learn More About Our Benefits.

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.

As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email CambiaCareers@cambiahealth.com. Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

CoreWeave is seeking an exceptional Sr Analyst, RevOps - Field Planning and Performance. This role sits at the intersection of data, operations, and strategic insight — ideal for someone passionate about uncovering what drives high performance in a sales organization and turning that insight into action.

You’ll work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, RevOps, Sales Enablement, Data Engineering and Finance to analyze sales performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support the execution of strategic initiatives across the funnel.

This is a pivotal moment for CoreWeave, as we scale our revenue operations infrastructure to support our trajectory as a newly public AI hyperscaler. Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the development of GTM strategies for new product launches or market entries
Monitor, analyze, and report on sales performance metrics across segments, verticals, and geographies
Identify performance gaps at the rep, team, and regional level, and propose data-backed recommendations
Partner with Sales Leadership and RevOps to build dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs that drive accountability
Support territory and quota planning, coverage optimization, and segmentation strategies
Conduct win/loss analysis, pipeline conversion studies, and sales cycle analysis to inform GTM motions
Provide strategic insights for QBRs, forecast reviews, and executive reporting
Collaborate with Sales Enablement to identify rep skill gaps and training opportunities based on performance data
Use AI tools (LLMs, AI copilots, workflow automation) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and forecasting, and help build a next-generation, AI-driven RevOps function.
Build and maintain predictive forecasting and long-range revenue models, not just review forecasts.


Who You Are


5+ years of experience in a GTM, strategy, business operations, or related analytics role.
Strong analytical skills with experience in Excel, SQL, BI tools
Experience working with CRM and sales enablement platforms (Salesforce, HighSpot, etc.).
Ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights and present them clearly.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in management consulting, PE, B2B SaaS, Cloud, or a high-growth technology company is a plus.
Bias to action in a fast-moving, hyper-growth environment.
High agency: you own outcomes, not tasks. You drive through ambiguity and complexity to the root cause, and you self-initiate the highest-impact work rather than waiting to be assigned it.
AI-first by default: you already reach for AI tools to work faster and smarter, and you are excited to help reinvent how a RevOps team operates with AI.

About

Be Curious at Your Core
Act Like an Owner
Empower Employees
Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
Achieve More Together

Title: Analyst/Senior Analyst, Product Growth & GTM Strategy
Description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Product Growth & GTM Strategy team is part of Salesforce’s Corporate Strategy organization, and partners with Product Management executives to drive business growth, Go-To-Market execution, strategic planning, business analysis, and growth across our product portfolio. The Analyst role is a hybrid of traditional roles in strategic planning, sales strategy, finance, and analytics – requiring a mix of market & business analysis, sales optimization, and business operational support. This analyst will work on a variety of global projects across functions and customer segments across our Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud product offerings.

Sample strategic projects include developing recommendations on go-to-market strategy, growth opportunities, customer segmentation, sales coverage, and investment prioritization. Operationally, the focus will be on forecasting, market sizing, performance trend analysis, sales pipeline analysis, and formulation of actionable recommendations. This person must feel comfortable interacting with senior management on a regular basis.

Deliverables include detailed analytic models, custom performance analysis, building a scalable reporting infrastructure, and packaging findings into presentation-ready content for Salesforce executives. The role requires interaction with multiple functional teams in the organization (such as Sales, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Customer Success) and provides exposure to senior executives. The successful candidate will have relentless curiosity and possess a passion for creating innovative analysis to identify opportunities. They will be comfortable diving into large datasets, excel at extracting insights from data, and converting ideas to action. They will be driven to build scalable analysis, leveraging opportunities to automate and streamline processes using the latest tools and features available.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


Lead ongoing analysis of business performance to support daily operations
Design and interpret key performance metrics. Deliver insights & recommendations
Maintain weekly forecasts of business performance for product leadership
Assist in developing and delivering presentations for senior executives, crafting the messages for sales and product leadership
Support strategic initiatives including evaluating areas of opportunity for the businesses
Troubleshooting operational issues as they surface; propose changes to systems/ processes to fix root causes
Prepare analysis and recommendations for strategic decision making
Partner with peer analysts to innovate and automate work processes using the latest analytics and AI tools, including Tableau Next, Claude, Slackbot AI, and Gemini


You're Our Person If...


2+ years' of experience (Analyst) and 4+ years' of experience (Senior Analyst) focused on quantitative analysis, financial modeling, and logical reasoning
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
Self-starter and high degree of motivation to go above and beyond the task at hand
Exceptional problem solving skills: demonstrated ability to structure complex problems, develop solutions
High degree of comfort running complex analyses and modeling in Excel or Google Sheets
Strong presentation skills, especially related to building compelling PowerPoint or Google Slides presentations
Work experience in management consulting, finance, product management, sales strategy, or sales operations is a plus
Experience aggregating large datasets using SQL, Python, and / or Tableau required
Experience automating and streamlining data analytics using AI tools a plus


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
Description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Business Intelligence Engineer and become the data expert who transforms how we work with our content partners and optimize our supply chain.

You'll be the go-to person for turning complex supply chain data into clear insights that drive real decisions. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you'll build the analytics tools and dashboards that help everyone understand what's working, what's not, and where we should focus next.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change - insights do. You'll tackle questions like: Where are the bottlenecks slowing down content delivery? Which partner workflows need improvement? How can we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You'll create the visibility tools that turn these questions into actionable answers, helping teams spot trends early and make confident, data-backed decisions.

What Makes This Role Different

You won't just be running reports - you'll be a strategic partner shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. Your work will directly influence how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide.

You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and build the tools that matter most. If you love diving deep into data, translating complexity into clarity, and seeing your insights drive tangible improvements, this role offers that impact.

Key job responsibilities


Analyze data to identify and execute on business opportunities
Understand data resources and select appropriate sources for each analysis
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products
Evaluate requirements and select optimal tools, balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Build data pipelines and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets to report product metrics and KPIs
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders verbally and in writing


About The Team

We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
Proven ability to determine when and how to integrate GenAI tools, evaluate and refine GenAI outputs, and apply responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
