Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Federal Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply


Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:


Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and managing robust, actionable data analytics and reporting products to support top-priority business needs and decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Data solutions. Develop and maintain data analytics solutions focused on enabling decision making, optimization, and measurable business impact for key functional and business stakeholders. Develop and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and analytical outputs.

Advanced Excel modeling skills preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Effective communication, both orally and in writing.
Strong documentation and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Title: Data Analyst III(Network Traffic Analytics)
Description:
Company Overview

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

What We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a skilled and analytical Data Analyst III to help understand and improve the performance of our satellite telecommunications network. In this role, you will analyze network traffic, service quality, usage trends, and operational data to identify patterns, investigate issues, and support data-driven decision making across the organization. Working with satellite network, RF, systems engineering, operations, customer-facing, and data teams, you will collect, analyze, and visualize data from multiple sources to help explain network behavior and support operational improvements. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets using SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, and other analytical tools. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, effective communication, and a willingness to develop expertise in satellite telecommunications and network operations.

What You’ll Do:


Analyze satellite telecommunications network data to identify trends, anomalies, service issues, and usage patterns that impact network performance or customer experience.
Investigate operational and customer questions by querying and analyzing data using SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, and other analytical tools.
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate network performance metrics, operational trends, and key findings to technical and business stakeholders.
Analyze network telemetry, call detail records (CDRs), session data, RF metrics, gateway performance, device usage, and other operational datasets.
Collaborate with RF Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to validate data, improve reporting accuracy, and support operational initiatives.
Build analytical datasets, semantic models, reports, and visualizations that support investigation, monitoring, root-cause analysis, executive communication, and customer-facing explanation.
Monitor key performance indicators such as throughput, latency, call success rates, beam utilization, gateway performance, and traffic trends.
Assist with capacity analysis by evaluating utilization patterns and identifying areas that may require further investigation or planning.
Confidently communicate findings through concise written summaries, presentations, Power BI reports, and ad hoc analysis; tailor the level of technical detail to executive, engineering, operational, or customer audiences.
Develop deep domain knowledge of Iridium's business, products, satellite architecture, network operations, customer usage patterns, and data landscape.


What You’ll Need to Succeed:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Typically requires 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, telecommunications, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregation strategy, temporal analysis, query troubleshooting, and the ability to work with large-scale data sets.
Strong Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, report design for analysis, drillthrough/drilldown, performance-aware semantic model design, and the ability to build reports that support investigation rather than only static reporting.
Experience analyzing operational, network, telecommunications, or other high-volume datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and performance issues.
Possess an analytical mindset, with the ability to understand a situation or problem and think critically to make decisions or come up with solutions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and to answer direct questions from senior leaders or external customers.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams and set priorities without guidance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to confidently present products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues
High intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn a complex technical domain without extensive oversight.


Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:


Experience in telecom, satellite communications, wireless networks, RF systems, network operations, or network quality/performance analytics.
Familiarity with RF/network concepts such as beams, channels, gateways, congestion, handover, link quality, signal strength, dropped sessions, capacity, availability, or quality of service.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, or machine-learning techniques, with the ability to choose practical methods appropriate to the business question.
Analytical engineering experience, including building curated marts, reusable metric layers, data quality checks, or pipelines with tools such as dbt or similar frameworks.


We’ll also need you to:


Be able to work in the office at least 60% of the time (3 or more days a week) to foster collaboration with the team and stakeholders
Be able to travel up 10%
Be a US Citizen


Work Environment:

This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer.

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. Under Iridium’s Hybrid Work Policy, employees are expected to work at least four days per week (approximately 80%) in an Iridium office to support collaboration, relationship-building, and professional growth.

Additional Information

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed.

Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $125,000 USD

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Base salary is only one part of our compensation package for this role. You may also be eligible for company stock and annual bonus. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid time off and paid holidays; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Iridium is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets using SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, and other analytical tools. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, effective communication, and a willingness to develop expertise in satellite telecommunications and network operations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Analyze satellite telecommunications network data to identify trends, anomalies, service issues, and usage patterns that impact network performance or customer experience.
  • Investigate operational and customer questions by querying and analyzing data using SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, and other analytical tools.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate network performance metrics, operational trends, and key findings to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Analyze network telemetry, call detail records (CDRs), session data, RF metrics, gateway performance, device usage, and other operational datasets.
  • Collaborate with RF Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to validate data, improve reporting accuracy, and support operational initiatives.
  • Build analytical datasets, semantic models, reports, and visualizations that support investigation, monitoring, root-cause analysis, executive communication, and customer-facing explanation.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as throughput, latency, call success rates, beam utilization, gateway performance, and traffic trends.
  • Assist with capacity analysis by evaluating utilization patterns and identifying areas that may require further investigation or planning.
  • Confidently communicate findings through concise written summaries, presentations, Power BI reports, and ad hoc analysis; tailor the level of technical detail to executive, engineering, operational, or customer audiences.
  • Develop deep domain knowledge of Iridium's business, products, satellite architecture, network operations, customer usage patterns, and data landscape.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically requires 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics, telecommunications, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregation strategy, temporal analysis, query troubleshooting, and the ability to work with large-scale data sets.
  • Strong Power BI skills, including data modeling, DAX, report design for analysis, drillthrough/drilldown, performance-aware semantic model design, and the ability to build reports that support investigation rather than only static reporting.
  • Experience analyzing operational, network, telecommunications, or other high-volume datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and performance issues.
  • Possess an analytical mindset, with the ability to understand a situation or problem and think critically to make decisions or come up with solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and to answer direct questions from senior leaders or external customers.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams and set priorities without guidance.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to confidently present products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues
  • High intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn a complex technical domain without extensive oversight.

  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, or machine-learning techniques, with the ability to choose practical methods appropriate to the business question.
  • Analytical engineering experience, including building curated marts, reusable metric layers, data quality checks, or pipelines with tools such as dbt or similar frameworks.

We’ll also need you to:

  • Be able to work in the office at least 60% of the time (3 or more days a week) to foster collaboration with the team and stakeholders
  • Be able to travel up 10%
  • Be a US Citizen

This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer.

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. Under Iridium’s Hybrid Work Policy, employees are expected to work at least four days per week (approximately 80%) in an Iridium office to support collaboration, relationship-building, and professional growth.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work for this role and is not a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be assigned additional responsibilities as needed.

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors and this range represents an estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Curology:

Curology's mission is to make effective, personalized skincare accessible. We were founded by dermatologists who believe everyone should have access to skincare products that actually work. Today, our licensed dermatology providers have helped millions of patients across all 50 states make that mission a reality.

We combine expert medical care with personalized prescription formulas and dermatologist-developed skincare essentials to deliver science-backed solutions that meet people where they are. Join us in our mission to transform skin health and enhance lives—one patient at a time.

Mission of the Role:

The mission of the Senior Data Analyst is to turn ambiguous business questions into analytics solutions that inform decisions — owning the work end to end, from problem framing through delivery and adoption. Reporting to the Analytics Lead, this role sits on the Data Analytics team and partners directly with stakeholders across the business.

Success depends on partnering with stakeholders to define the real question behind a request, recommend the right approach, and deliver visualizations and narratives that make the answer usable by non-technical audiences. The Senior Data Analyst connects each analysis to the broader business context rather than answering questions in isolation, and is accountable for the accuracy, documentation, and durability of what they ship.

Essential Functions and Impact Areas:

Stakeholder Consultation & Problem Framing


Partner with business stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Marketing, and Product functional groups to translate open-ended questions into scoped analytical problems with defined success criteria
Ask the follow-up questions that surface the decision behind the request, and push back when the requested output will not answer it
Recommend the analytical approach, including when a request warrants a reusable data asset rather than a one-off pull
Set expectations on scope and timeline, and communicate changes as work progresses


End-to-End Project Ownership


Own analytics projects from intake through delivery and adoption without requiring day-to-day direction
Source, validate, and model data in SQL to produce analysis-ready datasets
Document methodology, assumptions, and known limitations so results can be reproduced and reused
Build analytical assets that compound — reusable datasets, dashboards, and metric definitions rather than disposable outputs
Verify results against source systems before delivery, and surface discrepancies rather than reconciling them silently


Data Visualization & Storytelling


Design Tableau dashboards that answer a defined question for a defined audience, prioritizing clarity over comprehensiveness
Translate analysis into a clear narrative — what the data shows, what it means, and what decision it supports — calibrating depth to non-technical and senior audiences
Distinguish findings from interpretation and state confidence levels explicitly


Business Context & Cross-Functional Partnership


Help elevate the analytics function at Curology by supporting leadership with the insights they need to manage the business and measure outcomes
Connect analysis to how the broader business operates across patients, subscription lifecycle, and downstream financial impact
Partner with data engineering, analytics peers, and business teams to align on metric definitions and prevent duplicate sources of truth
Surface risks and opportunities stakeholders have not asked about
Handle patient and business data in line with Curology's privacy and security standards



Requirements

Required Qualifications:


5+ years in an analytics role delivering analysis directly to business stakeholders
Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization against large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, or similar)
Tableau experience building and maintaining production dashboards used by business teams, not one-off visuals
Track record of owning analytics projects end to end, translating ambiguous business questions into a defined approach and recommending the method rather than executing a specified request
Experience defining KPIs and developing metrics, scorecards, and performance reporting used by business teams and leadership
Experience with customer behavior analysis — retention, churn, cohort, and LTV — and defining segmentation used across analytics and reporting
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences in both written and live formats
Proficiency using AI as an execution partner to accelerate query drafts, design mockups, and polish outputs, while remaining fully capable of producing the work without AI. Corrects AI output and owns the quality of what ships


Nice-to-Haves:


Experience in a DTC subscription business
Experience supporting lifecycle or CRM marketing teams
Familiarity with email and SMS performance metrics and campaign measurement



Benefits

Location:


Remote (US)


Benefits & Perks:


💰 Competitive compensation and equity package (RSUs)
🥼 Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, FSA and HSA, supplemental coverages (critical illness, accident, hospitalization), and 401(k)
🧘🏻‍♀️ Access to wellbeing perks, including OneMedical, Spring Health, SoFi, and Employee Assistance Program
🌴 Flexible paid time off and holiday policy
🐣 Paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents)
💜 Employee donation matching program
🫱🏻‍🫲🏽 Culture Committee and employee resource groups for virtual and in-person connectivity
✨ Complimentary VIP Subscription to Curology or Agency, plus online retail discount


The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $160,000 per year, plus a competitive equity package and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including location, skills, experience, and job-related expertise.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! Description:
About The Role

We are looking for the VOC Data & Insights Specialist who thrives on turning raw data into actionable stories. In this role, you will be the bridge between our customer data systems and business decisions. You will be responsible for pulling data directly from APIs, querying a Data Warehouse as an advanced end-user, and building dynamic reports in Excel and Tableau.

A significant portion of this role focuses on Support Operations and Text Analytics. You will leverage Zendesk Explore to monitor support performance and use text analytics to extract meaningful customer sentiment and trends from unstructured data.

If you love data wrangling, have a knack for finding patterns in text, and enjoy building practical reports using both warehouse data and platform APIs, we want to hear from you.

You Will Be Responsible For


Data Extraction & Querying: Query data directly from our Data Warehouse to pull relevant operational datasets. Connect to and extract data from various platform APIs when direct warehouse integration isn't available.
Data Preparation: Clean, manipulate, and merge disparate datasets (from DWH, APIs, and manual uploads) to ensure accuracy and consistency before reporting.
CX & Support Analytics: Act as our internal expert for Zendesk Explore. Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards to track customer support KPIs, team productivity, and service bottlenecks.
Text & Sentiment Analytics: Analyze unstructured text data (customer tickets, feedback, chat logs) using text analytics techniques to identify emerging customer pain points, feature requests, and sentiment trends.
Report & Dashboard Creation: Design and maintain clear, user-friendly reports and dashboards in Tableau and Excel (utilizing advanced formulas, Power Query, and Pivot Tables) for cross-functional teams.


Our Successful Candidate Will Have The Following


DWH & API Familiarity: Strong experience as a DWH user (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) with the ability to write SQL queries to extract data. Experience working with APIs to pull data. SQL , Python.
Tool Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Excel (Power Query is a must) and hands-on experience building visualizations in Tableau.
Zendesk Explore: Direct, practical experience navigating and building custom reports within Zendesk Explore.
Text Analytics: Experience with text mining, sentiment analysis, or categorization of unstructured qualitative data.
Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot trends and anomalies that others might miss.
Communication: Ability to explain data concepts and insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. Hybrid work policy
4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle
Private health insurance
Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants

Title: Data Insights Analyst
Description:
Job Description




We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Gaming Insight Analyst to join our dynamic Insights team. In this role, you will be a crucial partner to the Casino Gaming and Marketing divisions, transforming raw data into the strategic intelligence that drives our business forward.




You will move beyond surface-level reporting to conduct deep, methodologically sound analyses of our Gaming products, marketing campaigns, and player behaviour.




Your primary mission is to challenge assumptions, uncover the "why" behind the numbers, and provide clear, actionable recommendations that optimise our investments, enhance player engagement, and grow our market share.




This is a high-impact role for a data-driven storyteller who is passionate about the Gaming industry and thrives on turning complex questions into profitable business decisions.




Qualifications




Proven analytical experience as a data analyst, marketing analyst, or product analyst role, preferably within the e-commerce, mobile, or online Gaming/Gambling industry.
Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience querying and manipulating large, complex datasets from data warehouses like BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake.
Strong, practical understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and the principles of A/B testing (e.g., control groups, statistical significance), to extract reliable insights from imperfect data.
Highly proficient with business intelligence tools such as Looker (or a similar tool like Tableau/Power BI) for data visualisation and building intuitive dashboards.
Ability to connect data insights to real-world business results and financial outcomes, acting as a business partner rather than just an analyst.
Excellent communicator who is able to clearly explain complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences in a simple and concise way.
Passion for casino games and a curiosity about the online gaming world, with a keen interest in understanding what drives player behaviour.




Additional Information




Designing, executing, and delivering post-mortems for marketing and promotional campaigns, going beyond top-line results to measure true incremental lift, ROI, and profitability, accounting for confounding variables and establishing clear attribution.
Applying a rigorous analytical framework to evaluate the performance of marketing activities and product changes (e.g., game positioning) while measuring the impact of these "tests," using statistical principles to assess their effectiveness and inform future strategy.
Analysing player behavior by segmenting our user base across various dimensions (e.g., New vs. Existing, Player Value Tiers, Game/Provider Preference) to better understand player loyalty and lifetime value.
Translating complex findings into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders in Gaming, Marketing, and Leadership; such insights will directly influence decisions on marketing spend, product strategy, and promotional calendars.
Developing and maintaining powerful, intuitive dashboards and reports in Looker to provide stakeholders with self-serve access to performance metrics.
Using LookML to define business logic, creating reusable data models, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy for all analytics built on top of our BigQuery data warehouse.

Title: Data Insights Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Gaming Insight Analyst to join our dynamic Insights team. In this role, you will be a crucial partner to the Casino Gaming and Marketing divisions, transforming raw data into the strategic intelligence that drives our business forward.

You will move beyond surface-level reporting to conduct deep, methodologically sound analyses of our Gaming products, marketing campaigns, and player behaviour.

Your primary mission is to challenge assumptions, uncover the "why" behind the numbers, and provide clear, actionable recommendations that optimise our investments, enhance player engagement, and grow our market share.

This is a high-impact role for a data-driven storyteller who is passionate about the Gaming industry and thrives on turning complex questions into profitable business decisions.

Qualifications


Proven analytical experience as a data analyst, marketing analyst, or product analyst role, preferably within the e-commerce, mobile, or online Gaming/Gambling industry.
Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience querying and manipulating large, complex datasets from data warehouses like BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake.
Strong, practical understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and the principles of A/B testing (e.g., control groups, statistical significance), to extract reliable insights from imperfect data.
Highly proficient with business intelligence tools such as Looker (or a similar tool like Tableau/Power BI) for data visualisation and building intuitive dashboards.
Ability to connect data insights to real-world business results and financial outcomes, acting as a business partner rather than just an analyst.
Excellent communicator who is able to clearly explain complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences in a simple and concise way.
Passion for casino games and a curiosity about the online gaming world, with a keen interest in understanding what drives player behaviour.


Additional Information


Designing, executing, and delivering post-mortems for marketing and promotional campaigns, going beyond top-line results to measure true incremental lift, ROI, and profitability, accounting for confounding variables and establishing clear attribution.
Applying a rigorous analytical framework to evaluate the performance of marketing activities and product changes (e.g., game positioning) while measuring the impact of these "tests," using statistical principles to assess their effectiveness and inform future strategy.
Analysing player behavior by segmenting our user base across various dimensions (e.g., New vs. Existing, Player Value Tiers, Game/Provider Preference) to better understand player loyalty and lifetime value.
Translating complex findings into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders in Gaming, Marketing, and Leadership; such insights will directly influence decisions on marketing spend, product strategy, and promotional calendars.
Developing and maintaining powerful, intuitive dashboards and reports in Looker to provide stakeholders with self-serve access to performance metrics.
Using LookML to define business logic, creating reusable data models, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy for all analytics built on top of our BigQuery data warehouse.

If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy turning complex data into clear, impactful solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Use SQL to extract, transform, and manage data from internal sources, ensuring it’s accurate and ready for analysis.
Analyze complex business problems, uncovering trends, root causes, and opportunities to improve performance.
Build and enhance Tableau reports and dashboards, turning data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
Partner with product, management, and cross-functional teams to define KPIs and support data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate closely with BI teammates and data engineers to improve data pipelines, reduce technical debt, and scale the Data Warehouse.
Proactively explore data beyond assigned requests. Anticipate surface trends, risks, and opportunities to bring insights before issues arise.

At least 2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar analytical role, supported by a relevant educational background (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field).
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming, and validating large datasets, writing complex queries, and optimizing performance. Knowledge of Python or R is an advantage.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau (or a similar BI tool), with the ability to present complex data in a clear and actionable way.
Solid understanding of data modeling, KPI design, metrics documentation, and statistical methods, with the ability to apply them to real business challenges.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively.
Analytical mindset with the ability to balance attention to detail while keeping the bigger picture in focus.
Self-driven and adaptable, with strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in verbal and written communication in English is essential, as it's our primary means of interaction.

Prioritize your well-being with monthly sports/health compensation, full sick leave coverage for the first 8 days, our in-house gym, and a chill games room to unwind.

In this role, you’ll be a key partner to the Marketing Department, working closely with the CMO and members of the Acquisition team to transform raw data into strategic intelligence that drives business performance.

This is not a surface-level reporting role. You’ll dive deep into marketing performance, iGaming product performance, and player behaviour to uncover the “why” behind the numbers. Your insights and recommendations will directly influence how we optimise marketing investment, improve player engagement, and grow market share.


What are we looking for now

  • A highly analytical and commercially minded Marketing Analyst to join our BI & Analytics team. In this role, you will be a crucial partner to the Marketing Department, collaborating closely with the CMO and members of the Acquisition team, transforming raw data into the strategic intelligence that drives our business forward
  • You will move beyond surface-level reporting to conduct deep, methodologically sound analyses of our marketing campaigns, iGaming products, and player behaviour
  • Your primary mission is to challenge assumptions, uncover the "why" behind the numbers, and provide clear, actionable recommendations that optimise our marketing investments, enhance player engagement, and grow our market share
  • This is a high-impact role for a data-driven storyteller who is passionate about the iGaming industry and thrives on turning complex questions into profitable business decisions


What You’ll do

  • Design, execute, and deliver post-mortems for marketing and acquisition campaigns, going beyond top-line results to measure true incremental lift, ROI, and profitability, accounting for confounding variables and establishing clear attribution.
  • Apply a rigorous analytical framework to evaluate the performance of marketing activities, measuring the impact of these "tests" using statistical principles to assess effectiveness and inform future strategy.
  • Analyse player behaviour by segmenting the user base across various dimensions (e.g., New vs. Existing, Player Value Tiers, Game/Provider Preference) to better understand player loyalty and lifetime value
  • Translate complex findings into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders in Marketing and Leadership; these insights will directly influence decisions on marketing spend, product strategy, and promotional calendar
  • Develop and maintain powerful, intuitive dashboards and reports in Looker to provide stakeholders with self-serve access to performance metrics


What You'll Bring

  • You will have proven previous experience working as a business data analyst in the domain of online acquisition marketing or a closely related field. Online casino or iGaming industry experience is welcome, but not strictly required
  • You hold a bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Marketing or related field
  • You have a strong analytical mindset, backed up by relevant skills for the ability to collect, organise, analyse, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
  • You are comfortable working with SQL and writing complex queries to retrieve, combine, transform and model data from different sources
  • You have hands-on experience in developing reports and dashboards in data visualisation tools such as Looker, Power BI or similar. Looker and LookML experience is preferred, but not essential


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Health Insurance & Fitness Benefit
  • Weekly team meals
  • Team-building events and parties
  • Learning & Development opportunities
  • A great working environment

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for the next professional opportunity, that will challenge you and advance your career? Join our team now!




Tickmill is looking to hire a Data Analyst to mainly collaborate with stakeholders and Product Owners/Analysts to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights based on data analysis.




About Tickmill.




Tickmill is an award-winning, multi-regulated broker offering access to a broad range of asset classes, including CFDs on Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, Cryptocurrencies, and Bonds, as well as Exchange Traded Derivatives like Futures & Options).




Founded in 2014, the Tickmill Group employs over 330 professionals across offices in London, Cyprus, Poland, Estonia, Seychelles and several other locations worldwide.

Our culture is built on trust, transparency, and high standards. We bring together ambitious professionals who are looking for an environment that supports them to dominate in their fields.

Our diverse, multilingual teams are focused on innovation, delivering bold excellence, and raising the bar wherever we can.

We offer competitive benefits packages, frequent team initiatives, and opportunities for professional growth. Join the Tigers!




What does the role look like?




The Data Analyst will have the chance to:

• Collaborate with stakeholders and Product Owners/Analysts to understand business requirements and support data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.

• Support the implementation of data-driven solutions that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

• Contribute to analytics projects related to product performance, client behavior, acquisition funnels, and client lifecycle analysis.

• Ensure data accuracy and consistency through validation and quality checks.

• Work closely with BI team members to improve reporting processes and analytical capabilities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, analytical techniques, and data visualization best practices.




What do you need to succeed in this role?

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role, preferably within the Finance/FX industry.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data accurately.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting and analytical solutions.

• Experience performing cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, retention analysis, and KPI performance monitoring.

• Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Power BI preferred).

• Strong SQL skills and understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, semantic models, and how to consume data from existing star schemas.

• Working knowledge of DAX and Power BI data modelling principles.

• Demonstrated ability to independently translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.

• Attention to detail, curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving business problems.

• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.




Will be considered as a plus:

• Experience with statistical analysis and A/B testing concepts.

• Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts and their business applications.

• Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and automation.

• Experience working with financial services, trading, or FX data.

• Familiarity with data governance and data quality best practices.

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and DataOps principles.

• Familiarity with Databricks or similar cloud platforms.

• Experience conducting market, competitor, or benchmarking analysis.




By joining us, you can expect:

• A Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.

• Attractive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience.

• Opportunities to learn and grow through our “Employee Training & Development program”.

• Stebby Sports Compensation or Confido Health Compensation.

• Multiple events to bond with the team and the group.

• Birthday and Loyalty benefits.




What to expect from our recruitment process:

Interview with HR
Assessment task
Interview with hiring managers
Final interview with top management




Make your next Career step and apply NOW!

*Due to the great number of applications, we receive for each of our open vacancies, we are unable to respond on an individual basis.

Title: Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst
Description:
Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions and rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver progress like never before and with double digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver better outcomes on scale, than Extreme.

Come become part of something big with us! We are a global leader, with hubs in Europe, North America, South America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East.

Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst

About The Role

We are seeking a “Supply Chain AI & Automation Analyst” to join our Extreme Networks Global Operations organization, where you'll turn complex operational data into clear, actionable insight that drives decisions and automation across our Global Supply Chan and Order Management teams. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, AI, and supply chain strategy, partnering with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, build analytical products, and tell the stories behind the numbers. The ideal candidate is a curious, technically strong analyst who is equally comfortable writing SQL, using AI tools, framing a business problem, managing a project, and presenting findings to stakeholders. You should be excited about the rapid evolution of AI and agentic workflows and how they can be applied to supply chain decision-making and you should be actively using AI tools in your work today.

A Note On Experience

This role requires commercially delivered analytical work. We will ask you at interview to walk through a specific project from problem through to business outcome that you owned and delivered in a professional setting. Academic or course-based projects do not qualify. If your experience is primarily from an academic programme, this role is not the right fit at this time

Key Responsibilities


Partner with supply chain stakeholders to scope problems and translate them into structured, measurable, automated workstreams.
Build and maintain python/SQL/Snowflake-based data models, dashboards, and self-service analytics for our global operations teams
Help operationalize AI and agent-based solutions to automate recurring analyses, augment decision support, and supply chain processes.
Apply statistical methods to inform data driven decisions across our global operations function.
Manage your projects end-to-end: scoping, stakeholder alignment, data discovery, modelling, validation, and rollout.
Translate analytical findings into compelling narratives (written, visual, and verbal) tailored to operational, business, and technical audiences.
Define and track KPIs that measure supply chain performance and flag interventions when metrics drift.
Contribute to ongoing improvements in data quality, documentation, and analytical standards across the team.


Required Skills & Qualifications


3-5 years experience in business analytics, data analytics, or a comparable quantitative role.
Demonstrated use of AI tools such as Claude, MS Copilot, or ChatGPT – in an analytical workflow, with a genuine appetite to develop agentic and automation capabilities in role.
Strong python skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks).
Demonstrated project management ability, owning deliverables across multiple stakeholders and timelines.
Solid grounding in descriptive statistics, and analytics fundamentals.
Strong data storytelling skills: the ability to distil complexity into clear visuals and narratives that drive action.
Supply chain domain knowledge: familiarity with demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, order management, logistics, procurement, or manufacturing operations.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or related).


Technical Skills Required


Programming for analytics: Python or R for modelling, automation, and analytics workflows.
BI and visualization tools: Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, Looker, or similar — both for building and for design literacy.
ERP / source systems: Exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud or similar transactional systems.


Preferred / Additional Skills: These are skills that would meaningfully strengthen a candidate for this role:


Practical experience applying agentic workflows (e.g., LLM-based assistants, retrieval-augmented analytics, automated reasoning agents) to analytical or operational problems.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Supply Chain, Mathematics, or related).
Forecasting and optimization: time-series methods as well as other optimization techniques.
Machine learning fundamentals: classification, regression, clustering, and an understanding of when ML is and isn't the right tool.
Process improvement methodologies: Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent structured problem-solving frameworks.
Stakeholder management and influencing: navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and building trust with non-technical partners.


What Success Looks Like


Within 3 months: deeply understand our supply chain data landscape, key stakeholders, and top-priority business questions.
Within 6 months: deliver at least one high-impact analytical product or AI-enabled workflow that changes how a decision is made.
Within 12 months: become a trusted analytics partner to supply chain stakeholders and a contributor to the broader analytics team's standards and practices.


Salary Is Based On Qualifications And Experience Between 60-70K

Extreme Networks Benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Digital Analyst - Product
Description:
Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.

The Role

Transform data into actionable insights that drive product decisions and enhance player experiences across our gaming platforms.

What You Will Be Doing


Guide product team members through complex data landscapes, providing valuable insights that support critical decision-making
Conduct deep-dive analyses of user behavior, app performance, and product features to boost player acquisition, engagement, and retention
Ensure top-tier behavioral data collection by collaborating with analytics developers on tracking implementation and issue resolution
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and alerting systems for real-time monitoring of key conversion metrics
Present insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders across the organization
Debug data issues and optimize tracking mechanisms to maintain data integrity


What We Are Looking For


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
Critical thinking mindset with proactive approach and high reliability
Solid SQL skills for querying and manipulating databases
Experience creating detailed reports and dashboards using tools like Looker or Tableau
Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Snowplow and GA4, plus tracking mechanisms and data layers
Experience with data modeling in Dataform and session replay/autotracking platforms is a bonus


Why you will love it

You'll be at the heart of product innovation, where your insights directly shape gaming experiences for millions of players. In our high-growth environment, you'll have the freedom to take ownership of impactful projects while collaborating with brilliant minds who value your expertise. Every analysis you deliver will drive real business decisions and help us stay ahead in the competitive gaming landscape.

Equal Opportunities

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas—nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

Title: BI Developer
Description:
Malta Based role working out of the Msida office(3 days a week in office)

Who We Are

Bally’s Intralot is a newly formed company established through the combination of Intralot and Bally’s International Interactive, positioning the group as a top iGaming operator and a leading global provider of lottery solutions.

Bally’s Intralot is uniquely positioned across digital online gaming markets, lottery, iLottery, and sports betting. Operating at the intersection of technology, regulation, and entertainment. We are optimally positioned to capitalise on strong global growth trends driven by digital adoption and regulatory expansion across lottery and iGaming markets.

Well, what about the team?

You'll be joining our Business Intelligence team based in Malta working hybrid 3 days a week in office , working alongside talented BI Developers, Data Engineers, Data Product Owners and stakeholders from across the business. We partner with teams including Insights, Acquisition, Retention, Player Management, Operations, Finance and Machine Learning to turn complex data into meaningful insights that drive better business decisions.

Our team is collaborative, curious and always looking for smarter ways to work. Whether we're building impactful dashboards, improving reporting processes or exploring new technologies like AI, we're passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference across the business.

So, what will you be doing?

As a BI Developer, you'll transform data into clear, actionable insights that help shape decisions across our global business. You'll work closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting and analytics needs, designing and developing dashboards and reports that provide real business value.

Building scalable reporting solutions, monitoring and improving data quality, and identify opportunities to optimise existing processes. From supporting regulatory reporting to carrying out ad-hoc analysis, you'll play an important role in ensuring our teams have the data they need to make informed decisions.

You'll also help evolve our BI capabilities by contributing ideas, improving performance and embracing new technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance the way we build and maintain reporting solutions.

And what will you need?

Experience


Experience in a Business Intelligence, BI Developer or similar analytics role.
Strong SQL skills with experience working with relational databases.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports using Tableau, Power BI or similar visualisation tools. Along with modern cloud-based data platforms, ideally Databricks.
Experience translating business requirements into clear, user-friendly reporting solutions.
Exposure to working in agile, fast-paced environments would be advantageous.
An interest in using AI tools to improve analytics, reporting and development workflows.


Skills & Behaviours


A naturally curious mindset with a passion for solving problems through data.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
A collaborative approach and the confidence to build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.
A proactive attitude with the ability to take ownership and see work through to completion.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality, accurate reporting.
Someone who enjoys challenging the status quo and continuously looking for better, smarter ways of working.


This Is What You'll Get

Different benefits packages are tailored to fit each location, but here’s a taste of what may be on offer:


Annual leave
Pension plan
Health insurance
Company share scheme
Volunteering days
Home office allowance
Wellness or Gym allowance


DNA / Values 

At Bally’s Interactive, we are driven by a set of core values that we like to call our DNA. We strive to embody our DNA and keep them at the heart of everything we do!

We are Always Ready to embrace change, adapt, and do what it takes to delight our customers. We believe that You Make the Difference, which is what gives our players the best experience and keeps them coming back. We are All One Team, looking out for each other, respecting diversity while connecting through a common purpose. Our teams are Learning Every Day by showing constant curiosity and the drive to learn from successes, mistakes, new experiences, and the people around us. At Bally’s we Love to Lead by thinking differently, seeking innovation, and always looking for ways to raise our game. 

Equal Opportunities 

At Bally’s Interactive, we are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and working conditions.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are important to us, and we encourage a culture where everyone can be themselves at work. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success, this is our superpower. 

We do not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, age, sex or sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, political opinion or disability.

Salary : €40k - €52k

Based In Malta office 3 days a week.

Title: Game Data Analyst (World of Warships, PC)
Description:
Job Overview

Wargaming is looking for a Game Data Analyst to work on World of Warships, World of Warships: Legends and World of Warships: Blitz in our brand to strengthen the World of Warships product analytics team. The position is dedicated to core game play and balance analysis.

You will be a part of the team working on analyzing, visualizing, monitoring and managing data of three World of Warships Franchise games. We cover all kinds of products’ needs ranging from in-game battle analysis to game economy and financial monitoring. We work extensively with game production team for both providing sufficient data for informed decisions and to enhance data processes within the development.




Reports to

Our future colleague will report to Lead BI Data Analyst




What will you do?

Work closely with internal customers and stakeholders from gameplay development teams to meet business requirements and transform them into valuable BI reports / research reports for senior management and product teams all over the globe;
Identify the key needs and point of growth of the development team and identify which data and how can enhance the decision-making process;
Define the format and to provide the decision support outputs (dashboards, ad hoc reports);
Determine key measurement metrics for new functionality and define tracking strategy;
Consult users and lead cross-functional teams to address business issues, if necessary;
Directly produce datasets and reports for analysis using various system reporting tools, if necessary.




What are we looking for?

3+ year experience on similar position;
Experienced player with a broad gaming background
Advanced knowledge of SQL at the level of complex queries;
Data visualization skills, proficiency with BI instruments (we use Tableau);
Good mathematical knowledge and knowledge of statistics;
Knowledge of Python popular libraries for data processing and analysis;
Experienced in working with DWH, overall understanding of DWH design and operations;
Written and spoken English (B2 and higher).




What additional skills will help you stand out?

Experience in game development (2+ years) and understanding of game production processes and needs;
Experience in Wargaming games
Understanding of multiplatform game analysis basics (PC, mobile, console).




Work mode

Hybrid (3 days of work from the office)
This role isn't eligible for relocation & immigration support.

Benefits and perks are tailored to the local market and culture. Our benefits in Nicosia include:

21 days annual leave (additional days based on years of service: up to 25 days)

HTML:
As a Quantitative Analyst, you will support power price and production forecast unit for math, optimization and in-depth data related tasks.

  • develop, maintain and continuously improve core forecasting, simulation and decision support solutions;

  • integrate weather-related models and data streams into systems;
  • develop and maintain renewable asset forecasting solutions at both the individual asset and portfolio levels;
  • prepare, update, and maintain technical documentation and presentation materials;
  • validate and backtest models, identify improvement opportunities, and collaborate with data engineers to implement enhancements;
  • contribute to cross-functional projects and other ad hoc data, modelling, and analytics initiatives.

With us, you can:

  • develop professionally through continuous training and development programs that expand your skills and experience;
  • opportunity for long-term career growth and self-fulfillment in a growing international company;
  • enjoy 5 additional vacation days after your first year;
  • choose a well‑being package that suits you, including health insurance and/or Stebby services.

  • have work experience in the fields of Data Analysis, Data Science, or Quantitative Analysis;
  • have strong analytical and data-related skills, including developing complex prediction models, solving optimization problems, automating, and handling large volumes of data;
  • are experienced in either R or Python, complemented by a basic familiarity with the other;

  • speak fluent English.

Apply latest by 10.09.2026.

Description:

Are you driven by data and have a talent for transforming insights into actionable strategies? We're seeking a talented BI Engineer to join our innovative team. Title: Data and Reporting Analyst - Support Services
Description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

THE ROLE:

As a Support Services Data and Reporting Analyst, you'll help teams across Support and Operations use data to make informed decisions, improve performance and automate recurring processes. You'll work hands-on across data analysis, reporting, platform integrations and automation - gathering requirements, analysing data from multiple sources, building data models, and helping teams establish reliable metrics and structures for internal stakeholders and clients.

This role increasingly works with data held in a cloud data warehouse, using modern data-transformation practices, so SQL is essential.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


Analyse data generated by Support and Operations activities, as well as data required by other business teams, to identify trends, answer operational questions and support evidence-based decisions.
Gather, clarify and document reporting and analytics requirements from stakeholders, including account management, customers, product development and other relevant teams.
Use SQL to query, validate, combine and investigate data, primarily through the company's data warehouse.
Develop, maintain and improve dashboards, reports and analytical solutions in Sigma Computing for multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Contribute to data modelling and transformation activities.
Integrate and reconcile information from relevant systems, which may include Microsoft Power BI, Excel, Salesforce, Monday.com and warehouse data.
Automate recurring reporting and operational tasks to improve accuracy, consistency and efficiency.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write queries for data extraction, filtering, joins, aggregation and validation.
Experience in data analysis and analytics, including interpreting business requirements, investigating data and communicating useful findings.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI, plus Sigma Computing or another business-intelligence/data-visualisation platform.
Knowledge of relational databases and core data concepts, with confidence working with structured data.
Experience handling complex Excel workbooks, including advanced formulas.
Experience integrating, comparing or reconciling data from multiple sources.
Strong documentation discipline and experience applying clear, consistent analytical standards.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Snowflake, dbt, Python or R.
Excel macros or automation.


The monthly salary for this full-time role ranges from €2790 to €3376 gross. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

You will work Monday to Friday, 8-hour days, with a start time between 10:00 and 20:00 (for example 10:00–18:00, 11:00–19:00 or 12:00–20:00).

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change 

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius.

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

Title: Growth Analyst
Description:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?


Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


About The Role

As a Growth Analyst, you will take ownership of our campaign spending decisions and contribute to the marketplace's success by meticulously analysing the return on investment (ROI). With your expertise, we'll be able to accurately determine the most strategic allocation of resources, including the exact location, timing, method, and amount spent on campaigns.

You will be working closely with other team members of the Growth domain, as well as Expansion Managers, Marketing and Operations teams. A Data Analyst will need to have good attention to detail and communication skills to succeed. Solid business sense and analytical mindset? You might be the campaign magician we’ve been waiting for.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Own campaign spending decisions for your assigned markets and optimise such decisions to help the country team reach their growth targets
Wrangle complex data sets to come up with testing hypotheses, setting up A/B tests (and other experiments) and analysing results using statistical techniques in order to guide your decision-making
Proactively working together with Expansion Managers, Marketing, Operations and local teams to drive collaboration and get the most out of our investments
Identify valuable opportunities in the team and contribute to global campaigns team playbook, processes and product requests


About You


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics
At least 3 years of experience in an analytical role dealing with large volumes of data. Experience in consulting, pricing/discount strategy and/or on-demand is a plus
Solid grasp of statistics and demonstrated experience with A/B testing
Amazing SQL and Excel skills. Experience with Python or R is a plus
Experience with some BI tools and data visualisation like Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Fluent in English


Why You’ll Love It Here


Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team and turn complex data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. In this role, you’ll work with large and diverse datasets, uncover patterns and opportunities, and use advanced analytics to help solve real business challenges.

If you’re naturally curious, enjoy tackling complex problems, and are passionate about transforming data into actionable insights, this is an opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.




The main responsibilities of the position include:

Apply statistical analysis and data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate insights and monitor key business metrics.
Support the evaluation and assessment of machine learning models through data analysis and performance reporting.
Contribute to the development of the department’s data science strategy and identify opportunities where data science can deliver business value
