Title: Data and Reporting Analyst - Support Services
Description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

THE ROLE:

As a Support Services Data and Reporting Analyst, you'll help teams across Support and Operations use data to make informed decisions, improve performance and automate recurring processes. You'll work hands-on across data analysis, reporting, platform integrations and automation - gathering requirements, analysing data from multiple sources, building data models, and helping teams establish reliable metrics and structures for internal stakeholders and clients.

This role increasingly works with data held in a cloud data warehouse, using modern data-transformation practices, so SQL is essential.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


Analyse data generated by Support and Operations activities, as well as data required by other business teams, to identify trends, answer operational questions and support evidence-based decisions.
Gather, clarify and document reporting and analytics requirements from stakeholders, including account management, customers, product development and other relevant teams.
Use SQL to query, validate, combine and investigate data, primarily through the company's data warehouse.
Develop, maintain and improve dashboards, reports and analytical solutions in Sigma Computing for multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Contribute to data modelling and transformation activities.
Integrate and reconcile information from relevant systems, which may include Microsoft Power BI, Excel, Salesforce, Monday.com and warehouse data.
Automate recurring reporting and operational tasks to improve accuracy, consistency and efficiency.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write queries for data extraction, filtering, joins, aggregation and validation.
Experience in data analysis and analytics, including interpreting business requirements, investigating data and communicating useful findings.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI, plus Sigma Computing or another business-intelligence/data-visualisation platform.
Knowledge of relational databases and core data concepts, with confidence working with structured data.
Experience handling complex Excel workbooks, including advanced formulas.
Experience integrating, comparing or reconciling data from multiple sources.
Strong documentation discipline and experience applying clear, consistent analytical standards.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Snowflake, dbt, Python or R.
Excel macros or automation.


The monthly salary for this full-time role ranges from €2790 to €3376 gross. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

You will work Monday to Friday, 8-hour days, with a start time between 10:00 and 20:00 (for example 10:00–18:00, 11:00–19:00 or 12:00–20:00).

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change 

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius.

Albourne is a global financial services company. Our objective is to advise our clients to be the best investors they can be. The company’s main areas of focus are fund research, portfolio and risk advice, FinTech and implementation. The Nicosia office opened in 1998; we currently have over 320 dynamic employees and are looking to have more to join our teams across various functions.




Role in Brief




We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Data Associate Analyst collaborating closely with the Hedge Fund and Alternative Risk Premia Investment Due Diligence (IDD) team and the Data team. The Data Associate Analyst is responsible for managing daily data updates, coordinating with 3rd party data providers including investment banks and hedge fund managers, and ensuring the accuracy and maintenance of Albourne’s database. Core tasks also include monitoring Albourne’s internally constructed indices —a suite of indices representing the aggregate performance of the Alternative Risk Premia universe—and handling client inquiries on indices and manager-related requests. The role also involves utilizing Albourne’s manager portal, to streamline communication with managers and ensure Albourne and its clients have access to the latest and most accurate information on Alternative Risk Premia products.




Insights to the Role




Establish external relationships with providers through effective communication
Data acquisition and processing
Detection of outliers, errors and delays.
Assist in the production of the monthly newsletter and ad hoc data related research pieces
Maintain and update Albourne’s database and internally constructed indices.
Collaborate closely with Investment Due Diligence strategy analysts and build strong working relationships with Data and Index teams.
Visualize key data insights through dashboards or charts to support decision-making.







Who You Are




Soft Skills:




Proactive, detail-oriented, and self-motivated.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Collaborative team player with a problem-solving mindset.
Exceptional time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.
Adaptable to changing business needs and environments.




Other Requirements:




University degree with a business/statistical /engineering background or any equivalent numerical degree
Fluent English
Computer literacy and experience in programming (e.g. R, Python)
Abide by Albourne Group’s policies and procedures
Comply with terms of Albourne Compliance Manuals
Attend Company and Function events upon request
Travel




What We Offer




Fully paid Medical and Dental Insurance for you and your dependents
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Provident fund Contribution
Yearly bonus dependent upon performance and company growth
Career growth and tools for ongoing learning and development
Annual bonus dependent upon performance and company growth
5 additional service recognition holidays in surplus to standard annual leave after 5 years of service
Albourne Training Days
Free office parking




What You’ll Enjoy




A supportive, multi-cultural work environment
Freedom to work independently, problem-solve and come up with creative solutions to complete tasks within required deadlines
Explore different roles within Albourne after you master your current role. There are excellent opportunities for horizontal and vertical career progression
Open plan office equipped with kitchen facilities and communal entertainment area
Fun social activities
Charity Day – a day in the year to work on a cause you are passionate about
We are supportive of fitness, mental health and wellness; implementing company-wide sessions for people to partake in activities related to these area

Data Analytics 4+ years (With strong focus on A/B testing)

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to effectively communicate findings to stakeholders.

• Support the implementation of data-driven solutions that improve business performance and operational efficiency.

• Contribute to analytics projects related to product performance, client behavior, acquisition funnels, and client lifecycle analysis.

• Work closely with BI team members to improve reporting processes and analytical capabilities.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role, preferably within the Finance/FX industry.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data accurately.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting and analytical solutions.

• Experience performing cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, retention analysis, and KPI performance monitoring.

• Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Power BI preferred).

• Strong SQL skills and understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, semantic models, and how to consume data from existing star schemas.

• Working knowledge of DAX and Power BI data modelling principles.

• Demonstrated ability to independently translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.

• Attention to detail, curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving business problems.

• Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.




Will be considered as a plus:

• Experience with statistical analysis and A/B testing concepts.

• Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts and their business applications.

• Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and automation.

• Experience working with financial services, trading, or FX data.

• Familiarity with data governance and data quality best practices.

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and DataOps principles.

• Familiarity with Databricks or similar cloud platforms.

• Experience conducting market, competitor, or benchmarking analysis.

• Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.

• Collaboration with SportBenefit.

First interview HR call
Task Assessment
Technical interview
Final interview with top management

Title: Process Analyst
Description:
About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Process Analyst to work as the data and analytics interface for Kerry’s Enzyme Process Technology (PT) Team. Embedded within the wider PT team, over three production sites, the role will focus on curating, structuring, analysing, and visualising process data across the entirety of the microbial enzyme production life cycle.

The successful candidate will partner closely with the PT teams on site to curate, structure and visualise manufacturing and process data from Kerry’s core systems (including SAP, EPM/MES platforms, SCADA systems and local Excel based datasets), turning complex and fragmented data streams into clear insights that support yield, recovery, productivity, process robustness and facilitate operational excellence.

Key responsibilities

Data Curation & Integration


  Extract, clean and harmonise process and manufacturing data from
  SAP (process orders, batch data, confirmations, material movements, yields)
  EPM / MES / LIMS / SCADA systems
  Site level Excel trackers and historical datasets
  Resolve inconsistencies between system data and off-line data repositories
  Improve transparency and traceability of process performance data
  Understand how SAP master data structures influence process orders, confirmations, yields, and performance reporting


Process & Manufacturing Analytics


  Analyse and trend process performance data across the end-to-end enzyme production process, including Inoculum preparation and cultivation; Fermentation metrics and profiles; and Downstream operational parameters and yields
  Support PT with robust analysis of key performance indices including yield and rolled throughput yield; recovery of unit operations; Enzyme titre and productivity; Losses, variability and deviation impacts
  Provide analytical support to process optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement projects
  Work with PAT and IoT-enabled sensors, historians, and data acquisition systems to contextualise high-frequency process data alongside batch and transactional datasets


Data Architecture


  Design and implement practical data frameworks and architecture to improve data accessibility and data reliability
  Reduce manual data handling by improving integration between SAP and reporting tools, while standardising data flows and calculation logic
  Work with each respective production site to align on data architecture and tools
  Clearly document datasets, assumptions and calculations used in PT reporting


Visualisation & Reporting


  Translate complex, multivariate datasets into clear, decision focused visuals, using Power BI dashboards for site, Excel based tools, PowerPoint etc
  Develop standardised visual and reporting templates to illustrate end-to-end process data


Collaboration within Process Technology


  Operate as a core member of the Process Technology team to help improve transparency and accessible to process data
  Leverage expertise from the PT teams to interpret biological data and benchmark expected process outcomes
  Work with the wide team to help coordinate how data may be collected, stored and modelled from operational process data and equipment


Qualifications and skills


  Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Science, Biotechnology, or related field with a MSc or PhD preferred
  Experience applying data engineering principles (data pipelines, transformations, data quality controls) in a manufacturing or process environment with complex and various data streams
  Solid industrial process/data analytics experience, operating at a moderate to advanced level
  Advanced capability in Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint and other related platforms is a necessity
  Experience in working with SAP and managing its datasets is a strong advantage
  A proven understanding of data modelling, architecture and scalable analytical frameworks
  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work within multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders
  Advanced English proficiency


Why Kerry?

In Kerry we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles, and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.

Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kerry and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.

Please note We do not accept CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies where Kerry terms of business have not been signed. Additionally, we will not consider or agree to payment of any recruiter fee under these circumstances. This also applies to CVs or candidate profiles sent directly to any Kerry Hiring Managers.

Playtech’s IMS team is on the lookout for a diligent, proactive, and detail‑oriented Reporting Engineer with strong analytical and system thinking skills

Your influential mission. You will…



Design and develop high‑performing SQL queries and reporting solutions that handle large and complex datasets
Troubleshoot and optimize existing reports, ensuring faster performance, improved scalability, and stronger data integrity

Collaboration and teamwork across diverse functions, where knowledge sharing is encouraged

Title: Data Analyst II

Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights.


Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)

Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.

Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.

You have a background working in similar fast paced product-driven teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed product decisions
You are a self-starter, focused on results, with a demonstrated background in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of a product
You have extensive experience with data visualisation tools mentioned above and develop compelling visualisations which influence decision making and business understanding
You have advanced SQL skills and intermediate Python skills & have experience leveraging AI capabilities to enhance data analysis, automate tasks, and improve decision-making processes
You have a background working in similar fast paced teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed decisions.
You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across the business and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!


Salary range: the expected base salary range for this position is between €32,000 - €48,000.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Join the Future of Data & Analytics at The Ardonagh Group

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an exciting new operation established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. As a centre of excellence for data and analytics, the Lab delivers data-driven insights that support colleagues and clients across the globe.

With more than 12,000 colleagues operating across a diverse portfolio of insurance products and related services, Ardonagh is committed to using data to transform decision-making, enhance client outcomes, and build a deeper understanding of risk.

Our mission is simple: use data, analytics, and innovation to achieve better outcomes for every participant in the value chain. We explore vast and complex datasets, uncover hidden opportunities, model future scenarios, and help clients and insurer partners prepare for the unknown.

We're now looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics Team and play a pivotal role in turning data into meaningful business insight.

The Opportunity

As a key member of the Data Analytics Team, you will work across a variety of datasets to both respond to business requests and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance across the Group.

You will bridge the gap between our Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams, ensuring that data is transformed into valuable insights that drive decision-making, operational efficiency, and commercial success.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically curious professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and influencing strategic decisions through data.

What You'll Be Doing


Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform decision-making, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and efficiency.
Partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Visualisation teams to understand available data sources and maximise their business value.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities within large datasets and provide recommendations that support strategic business decisions.
Enhance automated reporting and dashboards through proactive analysis, meaningful commentary, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and implementation of robust data governance, management, and reporting processes across the Group.
Explore and apply AI and machine learning techniques where appropriate to drive innovation and enhance business insight.
Contribute to the continued development of a world-class analytics function within the Ardonagh Analytics Lab.


What We're Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years' experience in data analysis and reporting.
Strong SQL expertise, including data querying, mining, manipulation, and segmentation.
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex datasets.
At least 2 years' experience using statistical programming languages such as Python or R.
Solid understanding of database concepts, structures, and data modelling.
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence principles and analytical best practices.
Experience with one or more BI tools, including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.


Desirable Experience


Experience within financial services.
Previous exposure to General Insurance is highly advantageous.
Knowledge of predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-based analytical techniques.


About You

We're looking for someone who:


Is an experienced analytics professional capable of working independently and taking ownership of outcomes.
Brings a proactive, solutions-focused mindset and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Has a genuine passion for transforming data into business value.
Quickly builds an understanding of business operations and technical environments.
Is a strong relationship builder who can confidently engage with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication and influencing skills.


Why Join Us?

At the Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, high-impact projects that influence decision-making across a global organisation. You'll join a collaborative team passionate about innovation, continuous learning, and unlocking the power of data to shape the future of insurance.

If you're excited by the opportunity to turn complex data into meaningful business outcomes and want to be part of a growing analytics centre of excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Starship Technologies is revolutionizing deliveries with autonomous robots. These robots are designed to deliver food, groceries, and packages across neighborhoods in minutes. Starship has now completed millions of autonomous deliveries to date, traveled millions of miles, and is currently doing more than 140k road crossings each day. Our contribution to society includes reducing congestion and pollution, providing zero-emissions deliveries, increasing the quality of life for residents, empowering seniors and disabled people, and enabling affordable delivery for local businesses.

We are growing fast, and we are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the team.

You will be a key strategic partner to our Commercial and Operational leaders, building the logic that proves the value of our technology and secures both our next level of commercial success and our ability to scale operations to match.

What the job is all about:

The boring part is done. Our data is accessible, the BI layer is solid, and most numbers already exist somewhere. You will not spend your first year digging yourself out of a data hole. What we don't have is enough hands to cover it all as deeply as we'd like. Your work splits in two:

Impacting company strategy - finding answers to questions nobody can answer yet. Should we scale? Where should we scale? At what unit economics? Why does one town work while the next one doesn't? These are “why?” and “what if?” questions, and they make up most of this role.

Freeing up time for the complex questions - making sure we don't have to answer the same questions over and over again. The knowledge mostly exists already, scattered across dashboards and people's heads. Your job is to pull it into the open so that people can answer the easy questions themselves and you can get to the more interesting ones.

Your main responsibilities are:

This role covers two domains that meet in the middle. The Commercial team asks where to expand and once we’re there, how to make it successful. Field Operations asks how we can run it well.

On the commercial side:


Find the root causes behind business trends to solve complex commercial problems and maximise volume. For example, why the order conversion rate dropped 20% at a site. High ETAs, payment gateway failures, dynamic pricing, school holidays, or an alien invasion?
Back our expansion decisions with evidence. Which grocery stores or restaurants in which towns should we go to next, weighing cost, drivability, routing efficiency, demographics, and store popularity. Should we prefer big cities or small towns?
Empower Commercial leaders by replacing static reports with dynamic tools, such as always-up-to-date partner dossiers, so the team negotiates with evidence rather than opinions.


On the operational side:


Be the analytical partner to Field Operations. Their days are full of concrete problems: robots idle in one hub while another misses deliveries, broken bots waiting for pickup, spare parts running out, fixes taking too long, spillages, etc. Your job is not to answer each one, but to help them frame the problem, put a number on it, set a target worth hitting, and check whether the fix worked. Most of these come back monthly with a different site attached, so building the logic once beats answering it eleven times.
Zoom out. Operations is, well, operational. Someone needs to step back and say what the biggest opportunities actually are - whether that is partner satisfaction, customer experience, cost per delivery, or revenue per robot - rather than waiting to be asked. That someone is you.


What’s in it for you?


A team worth joining. Small, senior, and self-aware. We ask for feedback, we take it, and we take pride in getting a lot done with limited resources, tackling problems nobody has solved before.
Real access, real influence. You will work with people at every level, from specialists to senior leadership across Commercial, Operations, Engineering and Product, as a partner rather than a service desk. Your analysis drives our decisions: whether we scale a market, where we go next, what we fix first. When the answer goes into a partner negotiation or a board discussion, you are the one who helps make sure it holds.
You are not starting from scratch. The platform is established: dbt, Databricks, semantic layer, Claude wired into our data stack, and pipelines that work. You inherit a foundation and build on top of it rather than rebuilding it.
The questions are unusually good. Because the product is physical and the business is multi-sided, an average question here needs several worlds joined together. Working out whether a town is worth entering means combining robot telemetry, partner order data, walking distances and terrain, human courier ETAs, and demographics. Working out why ETAs are drifting means separating autonomous driving behaviour from operational realities and weather conditions. There is no textbook and no playbook. You will connect datasets that were never designed to meet.
Room to grow. We are a fast-growing company where your contribution is visible, and there is plenty of room to grow - by deepening your expertise, taking on bigger challenges, or moving into new areas.
A flexible hybrid model. The team works mostly from home and gathers at the office 1-2 times a week.


What we hope you’ll bring to the table:


Solid experience in an analytical role, with a track record of business, growth or product analysis rather than reporting: Data, Business, BI, Growth or Product Analyst, Data Scientist, Solutions Engineer or similar.
Strong SQL skills, working with complex datasets.
Experience driving complex topics end-to-end, from a rough idea to a proposed plan, to executing the solution, and presenting it so that it is understandable and useful to everyone.
Pragmatic can-do mindset. You focus on impact rather than the beauty of the method, and decide pragmatically when a spreadsheet is enough and when the answer is a dashboard, a pipeline or an ML model.
The ability to get your point across to anyone, whether it is the Autonomous Driving team, the Commercial team or senior management.
Judgement about what matters. You can tell urgent apart from important apart from impactful, and you know the most urgent thing is usually neither of the other two.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
Beneficial: dbt, Databricks, Python or R, and experience with semantic or metric layers.

Their days are full of concrete problems: robots idle in one hub while another misses deliveries, broken bots waiting for pickup, spare parts running out, fixes taking too long, spillages, etc. Your job is not to answer each one, but to help them frame the problem, put a number on it, set a target worth hitting, and check whether the fix worked. Most of these come back monthly with a different site attached, so building the logic once beats answering it eleven times.
  • Zoom out. Operations is, well, operational. Someone needs to step back and say what the biggest opportunities actually are - whether that is partner satisfaction, customer experience, cost per delivery, or revenue per robot - rather than waiting to be asked. That someone is you.

What’s in it for you?

  • A team worth joining. Small, senior, and self-aware. We ask for feedback, we take it, and we take pride in getting a lot done with limited resources, tackling problems nobody has solved before.
  • Real access, real influence. You will work with people at every level, from specialists to senior leadership across Commercial, Operations, Engineering and Product, as a partner rather than a service desk. Your analysis drives our decisions: whether we scale a market, where we go next, what we fix first. When the answer goes into a partner negotiation or a board discussion, you are the one who helps make sure it holds.
  • You are not starting from scratch. The platform is established: dbt, Databricks, semantic layer, Claude wired into our data stack, and pipelines that work. You inherit a foundation and build on top of it rather than rebuilding it.
  • The questions are unusually good. Because the product is physical and the business is multi-sided, an average question here needs several worlds joined together. Working out whether a town is worth entering means combining robot telemetry, partner order data, walking distances and terrain, human courier ETAs, and demographics. Working out why ETAs are drifting means separating autonomous driving behaviour from operational realities and weather conditions. There is no textbook and no playbook. You will connect datasets that were never designed to meet.
  • Room to grow. We are a fast-growing company where your contribution is visible, and there is plenty of room to grow - by deepening your expertise, taking on bigger challenges, or moving into new areas.
  • A flexible hybrid model. The team works mostly from home and gathers at the office 1-2 times a week.

What we hope you’ll bring to the table:

  • Solid experience in an analytical role, with a track record of business, growth or product analysis rather than reporting: Data, Business, BI, Growth or Product Analyst, Data Scientist, Solutions Engineer or similar.
  • Strong SQL skills, working with complex datasets.
  • Experience driving complex topics end-to-end, from a rough idea to a proposed plan, to executing the solution, and presenting it so that it is understandable and useful to everyone.
  • Pragmatic can-do mindset. You focus on impact rather than the beauty of the method, and decide pragmatically when a spreadsheet is enough and when the answer is a dashboard, a pipeline or an ML model.
  • The ability to get your point across to anyone, whether it is the Autonomous Driving team, the Commercial team or senior management.
  • Judgement about what matters. You can tell urgent apart from important apart from impactful, and you know the most urgent thing is usually neither of the other two.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Beneficial: dbt, Databricks, Python or R, and experience with semantic or metric layers.

Want to learn more about our robots and our people? Get in touch and let’s have a chat!

Title: Quantitative Analyst
HTML:
As a Quantitative Analyst, you will support power price and production forecast unit for math, optimization and in-depth data related tasks.

In this role, you will:

  • develop, maintain and continuously improve core forecasting, simulation and decision support solutions;
  • design and implement tools for forecasting, and operational planning;
  • contribute to quantitative models, algorithmic solutions, data processing workflows, and system automation initiatives across multiple business domains;
  • handle and process weather-related datasets, including gridded data sources;
  • integrate weather-related models and data streams into systems;
  • develop and maintain renewable asset forecasting solutions at both the individual asset and portfolio levels;
  • prepare, update, and maintain technical documentation and presentation materials;
  • validate and backtest models, identify improvement opportunities, and collaborate with data engineers to implement enhancements;
  • contribute to cross-functional projects and other ad hoc data, modelling, and analytics initiatives.

Enefit offers:

  • monthly salary starting from EUR 3000,- gross;
  • professional growth through continuous training and development; programs that expand your skills and experience;
  • opportunity for long-term career and self-fulfillment in a growing international company;
  • 5 additional vacation days after your first year;
  • attractive health insurance package.

You are a great match if you:

  • have work experience in the fields of Data Analysis, Data Science, or Quantitative Analysis;
  • have strong analytical and data-related skills, including developing complex prediction models, solving optimization problems, automating, and handling large volumes of data;
  • are experienced in either R or Python, complemented by a basic familiarity with the other;
  • are familiar with data workflows, including data storage, access, and transformation (SQL, data import/export, and Parquet files);
  • are a results-oriented team player with an eagerness to learn;
  • hold a university degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field;
  • speak fluent English.

Additional Details

Location: Riga. Partial remote work opportunity.

Application deadline 10.09.2026

Title: DUOMENŲ ANALITIKĖ (-AS)
HTML:
Ar nori tapti „Ignitis Group“ dalimi?

Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) duomenų analitikos komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už analizę, elektros energijos prekybai vykdyti. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:


  • Kuriant IT ir analitinius įrankius duomenų gavimui, analizei, procesų optimizavimui, procesų stebėsenai ir automatizacijai;
  • Analizuojant kaip tikslinti duomenų prognozes;
  • Inicijuojant, diegiant ir tobulinant naujus analizės modelius;
  • Kuriant įrankius kitiems įmonės specialistams, ruošiant ataskaitas savarankiškai;
  • Vykdant didmeninės rinkos modeliavimą;
  • Rengiant įvairias nestandartines analizes;
  • Tobulinant ir administruojant automatinės prekybos sistemas;
  • Reguliariai besidomint naujausiomis duomenų analizės srities tendencijomis.


Šiai pozicijai svarbu:


  • Aukštasis universitetinis išsilavinimas (ekonometrijos, statistikos, matematikos ar kitų panašių tiksliųjų mokslo srityse);
  • Programavimo patirtis ir geras išmanymas „SQL“ ir „Python“ bei makrokomandų kūrimas „MS Excel“, „Power Query“, „VBA“
  • Sugebėjimas naudoti vizualizacijos įrankius, pvz., „Power BI“, ir kurti aiškias, suprantamas ir efektyvias duomenų vizualizacijas.
  • Didelių duomenų („big data“) technologijų supratimas.
  • Duomenų integracinių („API“) sprendimų supratimas, gebėjimas konfigūruoti ir jų programavimas.
  • Elektros rinkos veikimo principų išmanymas;
  • Analitinis mąstymas, duomenų raštingumas, geri problemų sprendimo įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas vizualiai ir aiškiai pateikti apibendrintą informaciją ir analitines įžvalgas.


Privalumas būtų:


  • Ankstesnė prekybos patirtis elektros / kitų žaliavų / akcijų / valiutų biržoje;
  • Su energetika susijusių duomenų dalinimosi platformų išmanymas;
  • Darbo vieta: Kruonis/Kaunas.


Mainais už tvaresnės ateities kūrimą, mes pažadame:


  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Skani dienos dalis: pusė pietų kainos padengiama įmonės, o kava ir vaisiai visada po ranka;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms;
  • Įvairovę ir įtrauktį puoselėjančią darbo kultūrą;
  • Papildomą skatinimą dalyvaujant Grupės iniciatyvose.


Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Pareigybių grupės pastovios atlyginimo dalies intervalas: yra nuo 2770 iki 4150 EUR (neatskaičius mokesčių). Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį ir kompetenciją. Prie darbo užmokesčio gali būti mokama kintamoji atlygio dalis.

Apie mus:

Norėtum prisidėti prie projektų, užtikrinančių energetinį saugumą mūsų namams? „Ignitis grupė“, kurios svarbią dalį sudaro „Ignitis gamyba“, yra Baltijos šalyse pirmaujanti integruota energetikos įmonių grupė. Pagrindinis mūsų siekis yra sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

„Ignitis gamyba“ valdo ir plėtoja didžiausius elektros energijos gamybos pajėgumus Lietuvoje. Elektrėnų kompleksas, didžiausia atsinaujinančius energijos išteklius gaminanti elektrinė Lietuvoje – Kauno hidroelektrinė, bei vienintelė tokio tipo elektrinė Baltijos šalyse – Kruonio hidroakumuliacinė elektrinė, padeda užtikrinti šalies energetikos sistemų saugumą ir patikimumą.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!

Here’s How You Will Be Contributing


Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
Data Pipeline Ownership. Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis. Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
Strategic Support and Analysis. Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC/FinCrime function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.
Performance Tracking and Initiative Optimisation. Monitor and track the performance of key strategic initiatives, capitalising on optimisation opportunities to enhance operational outcomes.
KPI Implementation and Target Setting. Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Process Standardisation. Collaborate closely with various stakeholders to standardise processes across forecasting, scheduling, and real-time operations, promoting continuous improvement and strategic alignment.


This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

What You Will Bring


Quantitative Foundation. Ideally, you have a background in statistics, maths, physics, engineering, economics, or another scientific field. You apply first-principles thinking to break down complex operational problems.
A Statistical Mindset. You have a natural grasp of data logic. You don't just look at averages; you understand distributions, variance, and significance. You enjoy applying that rigor to messy, real-world operational data to separate signal from noise.
You have 4+ years of experience in analytics with demonstrated ability to approach complex problems with a strategic mindset, identifying innovative solutions that drive operational improvements.
You have a background working with operational team analytics including capacity planning, forecasting, efficiency analysis, quality assurance, predictive analytics, and experimentation.
You have experience working with complex data models in SQL (our warehouse is Snowflake) and analysing it using advanced SQL/Python/R
Able to demonstrate that you can tell a story and proactively give guidance on strategy based on insights
You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate storytelling ability with data
You have a bias to action - you identify what needs to be done and make it happen.


Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)


Prior experience in Operation domains
You have experience working with a WFM or Quality team.
You have experience working with WFM Systems
You have experience with forecasting techniques such as ARIMA, Holt-Winters, and other time series analysis methods


Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Title: Duomenų mokslo analitikas (-ė)
Description:
„IKI“ – tai vieta, kur žmonės, nepriklausomai nuo to, ar dirba biure, parduotuvėse, gamyboje ar logistikoje, aistrą pirmauti verčia ambicingais pasiekimais! Pirmieji Lietuvoje pristatėme prancūziškus kruasanus ir bagetes, atidarėme autonominę parduotuvę, įdiegėme savitarnos kasas ir elektronines kainų etiketes. Šie žingsniai atspindi mūsų nuolatinį siekį būti žingsniu priekyje ir kurti ateities mažmeninę prekybą – inovatyvią bei tvarią. Jei ieškai dinamiškos, idėjoms atviros aplinkos, kurioje galėtum augti ir kurti naujoves, gali būti, kad darbas „IKI“ yra arčiau tavęs!

Šiame darbe tu:


Kursi, diegsi ir prižiūrėsi statistinius modelius, prognozavimo algoritmus bei mašininio mokymosi sprendimus.
Analizuosi verslo eksperimentų (A/B testų, pilotinių projektų) rezultatus ir vertinsi jų poveikį verslo rodikliams.
Automatizuosi analitinius procesus.
Vizualizuosi analizės rezultatus, rengsi įžvalgas ir rekomendacijas, padedančias priimti duomenimis grįstus verslo sprendimus.
Bendradarbiausi su IT, prekybos, rinkodaros, tiekimo grandinės ir logistikos komandomis, ieškant galimybių gerinti veiklos rezultatus pasitelkiant duomenų analitiką.
Nagrinėsi struktūrizuotus ir nestruktūrizuotus duomenis, identifikuosi tendencijas, dėsningumus bei priežastinius ryšius.
Prisidėsi prie analitikos metodikų, standartų ir gerųjų praktikų kūrimo bei jų diegimo organizacijoje.


Tikimės, kad tu:


Turi universitetinį išsilavinimą tiksliųjų mokslų srityje (matematikos, informatikos, ekonomikos, fizikos ir kt.)
Turi ne mažesnę kaip 2 metų patirtį dirbant duomenų mokslo, analitikos srityje
Turi gerus Python, SQL ir Excel įgūdžius
Puikiai bendrauji anglų kalba
Gebi savarankiškai vykdyti analizės projektus – nuo verslo problemos identifikavimo iki sprendimo rekomendacijų pateikimo


„IKI“ pasiūlymas tau:

Atlyginimas ir finansinė gerovė


atlyginimas: 2800 – 3800 €/mėn. (neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo tavo patirties ir įgūdžių),
galėsi pigiau apsipirkti „IKI“ prekybos centruose,
turėsi nuolaidas „IKI“ asortimento naujienoms,
daugiau nei 300 MELP ir partnerių nuolaidų kone visiems gyvenimo atvejams.  


Darbo aplinka ir lankstumas


hibridinis darbo modelis: galimybė dirbti patogiame „IKI“ biure arba namuose,
lankstumas pasirenkant darbo valandas,
įkvėpimui – darbostogos iki 30 d. per metus.


Karjera ir tobulėjimas


karjeros galimybės (tiek Lietuvoje, tiek užsienyje),
profesinio tobulėjimo galimybės (tiek su kolegomis, tiek ir individualiai).


Sveikata ir emocinė gerovė


papildomas sveikatos draudimas, kurį galėsi rinktis net iš 3 planų,
nemokamos sveikatos patikros biure,
dalyvavimas „Walk15“, vidinėse badmintono, dviračių, žygių mėgėjų sporto grupėse,
streso valdymo ir kiti emocinės gerovės mokymai, galimybė gauti anonimines psichologo konsultacijas telefonu.     


Stipri bendruomenė


stiprybėmis grįsta kultūra, kurioje vertinamos visų darbuotojų unikalios savybės ir pasiekimai,
kolegas pagal laisvalaikio veiklas kviečiame burtis į „Hobby Spotlight” klubus,
darbuotojų fondas „VeIKIme drauge“,
esame aktyvūs bendruomenės nariai – savanoriaudami ir finansine parama prisidedame prie „Maisto banko“ ir kitų organizacijų.  


Inovacijos ir dinamiškumas


modernūs darbo įrankiai ir programos,
inovatyvūs sprendimai prekyboje, tvarumo ir kitose srityse,
mūsų komandos projektus ir pasiekimus kviečiame pažinti čia: Tvarumas | IKI. Arčiau Tavęs!


Skamba kaip darbas arčiau tavęs ir tavo tikslų?

Pasidalink savo CV arba susisiek su mūsų atrankų specialiste Vilte, telefonu +370 658 99876 arba LinkedIn platformoje.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Office and be allocated to the Product domain. You will partner closely with Product, Commercial, and Engineering teams to understand user behaviour, evaluate and generate product hypotheses, design and analyse experiments, improve key business and product metrics, and build scalable analytics foundations such as metrics, data marts, dashboards, and alerting.

Key responsibilities

Product analytics & insights

Analyse user behaviour and product journeys across web and mobile applications: funnels, activation, engagement, retention, monetisation, and feature adoption.
Identify drop-offs, behavioural patterns, friction points, and growth opportunities and translate them into actionable product hypotheses.
Evaluate the impact of product launches and changes and explain what changed, why it changed, and for whom.

Experimentation & hypotheses

Work with the Product team to formulate and prioritise hypotheses and define measurable success criteria.
Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments, including primary metrics, guardrails, sample-size considerations, segmentation, and statistical interpretation.
Ensure experiment results are translated into clear product decisions and next steps, not just statistical conclusions.

Metrics & product monitoring

Define and maintain product KPIs and metric trees, ensuring consistent definitions across teams.
Develop dashboards and analytical views that help Product teams understand performance without relying on manual analysis.

Segmentation & behavioural research

Build meaningful user and behavioural segmentations based on lifecycle stage, product usage, engagement, monetisation, and other relevant characteristics.
Analyse differences between user cohorts and segments to understand which product experiences work for whom.

Data foundations & analytics quality

Formulate analytical and business requirements and actively participate in building product data marts and single-source-of-truth datasets.
Partner with Engineering and Data Engineering on event tracking and instrumentation, ensuring new features generate reliable and useful analytical data.
Improve the product metrics system, including definitions, documentation, ownership, and consistency.

What we expect (must-have)

3+ years of experience in data analytics (fintech/product experience is a strong plus).
Strong SQL+Python and hands-on experience working with large datasets.
Strong understanding of product analytics concepts: funnels, conversion, retention, cohorts, engagement, monetisation, and segmentation.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment analysis, including statistical significance, confidence intervals, guardrail metrics, and common sources of bias.
Experience with product analytics tooling and event-based tracking.
Ability to communicate insights clearly and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice-to-have

Experience building analytical data marts or working with dbt-style analytics engineering workflows.
Experience owning event tracking across web and mobile applications.
Understanding of marketing analytics, acquisition, and attribution.

Our technological stack

Databases: Snowflake, ClickHouse, MySQL, BigQuery
Visualisation systems: Tableau, HEX
Analytics tools: Amplitude
Programming language: Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn)
Interactive environments: Jupyter Notebook, HEX

Title: Data Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job Title:

Data Reporting Analyst

Contract Type:

Time Type:

Full time

Job Description:

The Data Reporting Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, consistency, and analytical value of trading and financial data used by the Controlling and Accounting functions. The role supports Trading Controllers and business stakeholders through the development of robust reporting solutions, reconciliation analysis, dashboard creation, and data governance activities.

Acting as a key link between Controlling, Accounting, Risk, Trade Support, and IT teams, the incumbent ensures that business data is accurately mapped, validated, and transformed into actionable insights that support financial performance monitoring and decision-making. The role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives through the automation of reporting processes, enhancement of data quality controls, and implementation of analytical tools that improve the visibility of desk profitability, balance sheet positions, and cash flow performance.

The successful candidate combines strong financial acumen with advanced analytical and reporting capabilities, enabling the organization to move from historical reporting toward forward-looking analysis and enhanced business intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

Data Accuracy & Mapping


Collaborate with the Trading Data Reporting Analyst to verify and maintain accurate mappings.
Ensure correct data classification and structure to support precise analysis.



Report Generation & Dashboard Development


Create detailed reports using data from various sources to provide stakeholders with key insights into performance metrics.
Develop interactive dashboards to detect and correct data discrepancies, particularly in:
Desk performance and analytical dimensions view
Desk balance sheet view
Desk cash flow (CF) view

Data Analysis & Reporting


Conduct in-depth analysis of trading data to support decision-making and identify potential improvements.
Provide regular reports on trading data accuracy and mapping, including:
Daily PnL estimation – ensure accuracy and highlight significant movements.
Monthly and year-to-date (MtD & YTD) trading reconciliation – review and explain variations by nature, cost structure, cut-off points, trends, volumes, and counterparties.

Process Documentation & Improvement


Document existing workflows to enhance process visibility and identify optimization opportunities.
Recommend and implement process improvements to streamline data reporting.



Ad-hoc Tasks & Support


Assist with various ad-hoc requests aligned with Trading Controller (TC) goals, targets, and performance initiatives.
Provide replacement for another team member in case of temporary absence (incl. vacation, sickness, business trip, etc.).



Profile


Financial reporting, controlling, management accounting, or business analytics.
Data analysis and reporting within commodities trading, financial services, banking, energy, or related industries.
Proven experience reconciling and analyzing P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow information.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple source systems and ensuring data integrity and consistency.
Strong understanding of reporting processes, financial controls, and performance measurement methodologies.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Position: BI Analyst (Tableau & Revenue Operations)

Location: On site (Larnaca or Limassol)

Department: Data & Analytics




About Us

Our company is a leading provider of cloud contact center solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our innovative platform offers a full range of features and capabilities, including intelligent routing, IVR, call recording, analytics, and more. We are growing rapidly and expanding our global footprint, and we are looking for a talented Sales professionals to help us expand our client base.




Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive BI Analyst to become the core owner of our Tableau ecosystem. Our organization is heavily sales-driven, meaning your work with data will directly impact our revenue growth. You will be responsible for building high-quality interactive dashboards, managing our Tableau Server, and working closely with the Revenue team to track the sales pipeline and conversion rates.




The ideal candidate is someone who is technically skilled in Tableau and SQL but also has the "business curiosity" to understand how our operations works and where we can improve.




Key Responsibilities

1. Tableau Development & Admin

Dashboarding: Create functional, interactive, and visually polished dashboards in Tableau that stakeholders actually enjoy using.
Server Maintenance: Manage Tableau Server (handling user access, permissions, and organizing the project structure).
Data Freshness: Manage and monitor Tableau Extracts and subscriptions to ensure data is always up-to-date and accurate.

2. Sales & Revenue Support

Funnel Analysis: Build and maintain reports on sales pipeline, conversion stages, and lead velocity.
Ad-hoc Reporting: Provide quick, accurate data insights using Excel or Tableau to support urgent business decisions.
Proactivity: Don’t just build what is asked — analyze the data and suggest where the business might be missing opportunities.

3. Collaboration & Processes

Requirements Gathering: Communicate with business users to understand their needs and turn them into clear technical requirements.
Data Pipeline: Coordinate with data engineers to explain what datasets you need to build the best possible dashboards.




Requirements

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in BI or Data Analytics.
Tableau Stack: Proficiency in Tableau Desktop (LODs, Parameters, Sets) and experience with Tableau Server administration.
SQL: Solid ability to write queries to extract and transform data.
Excel: Advanced user (Pivot tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
Business Mindset: Understanding of basic sales metrics (Pipeline, Conversion, Win Rate, Churn, MRR).
Language: Professional working proficiency in English.




Nice to have:

Python: Basic scripting for data tasks.
Statistics: Understanding of core statistical concepts.
Vibe Stack: Cursor for development, n8n for workflow automation, and an understanding of how to prompt/deploy AI agents for data tasks.




Key Competencies

Attention to detail: You double-check your numbers before showing them to the manager.
Organization: You can manage multiple requests without losing track of priorities.
Communication: You can explain "what the data says" to someone who isn't a data person.




What We Offer:

Play a crucial role in growing our product.
Attractive compensation and benefits.
Top-notch work gear.
Embrace a flexible hybrid work model.
Free lunch and healthy snacks every day.
Medical insurance.
A team of talented and fun colleagues from different countries.




At Voiso, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all team members.

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
Patrianna is a B2B business supporting the major players in the Social Gaming Industry. Active since 2022 we are scaling our structure from a start-up into a more mature business.

We are seeking an exceptional Data Analyst to oversee and optimize the performance of our diverse gaming brands. In this role, you will also be responsible for shaping best practices, establishing common procedures, and ensuring knowledge is effectively shared across the commercial team. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at the intersection of analytics and business strategy.

What You'll Do:


Brand Performance & Optimization: Evaluate and manage the performance of multiple gaming brands, identifying opportunities to drive growth, improve operational efficiency, and enhance overall business results.
Data-Driven Insights: Utilize data analytics to uncover trends, challenges, and opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to inform brand and business strategies.
KPI Monitoring: Design and maintain dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance metrics across the business, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
Best Practices & Knowledge Sharing: Develop and implement best practices and common procedures for the commercial team, ensuring consistency and fostering a culture of collaboration and shared learning.
Strategic Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, and operations teams to align brand strategies with overall company objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach to business goals.
Stakeholder Engagement: Present insights, strategies, and updates to senior leadership, fostering alignment and driving informed decision-making.
Advanced Analytics Development: Champion the integration of cutting-edge analytical techniques, including exploring innovative technologies and methodologies, to continually refine and enhance business performance.


What You'll Need:


Strategic Acumen: Experience in developing and executing strategies that enhance brand performance and drive business growth.
Analytical Expertise: Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
Leadership Skills: A proven track record of managing teams or leading cross-functional initiatives to deliver measurable results.
Knowledge Sharing: Demonstrated experience in creating and maintaining knowledge-sharing frameworks to support team efficiency and collaboration.
Gaming Industry Knowledge: A deep understanding of gaming trends, consumer behavior, and market dynamics.
Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying challenges and crafting innovative solutions.


Bonus Points For:


Experience with Python or other programming languages.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL processes, or predictive analytics.
Experience working with advanced analytical frameworks or developing new methodologies leveraging emerging technologies.


Why Join Patrianna?


Impactful Role: Lead the charge in optimizing the performance of a diverse portfolio of gaming brands and shaping the way the commercial team operates.
Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a generous salary and benefits package.
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and advancement in a dynamic and innovative industry.
Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team that values creativity, teamwork, and excellence.

Title: Quantitative Data Analyst in Credit Risk Model Validation | SEB, Vilnius
Description:
SEB is a leading northern European financial services group with a high focus on risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and governance. Banking is transforming at pace, our talented and rapidly expanding quant team is committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a strong risk culture. Does that sound like a fit for you?

What You Will Be Doing

You will be a part of a professional team within SEB Group CRO organization that ensures quality of models used for measuring credit risk. We conduct in-depth reviews of the models to ensure quality performance by assessing model design and modelling methodologies, performance from the statistical point of view, data quality, implementation, regulatory compliance, and usage.

We work closely with model developers, owners, users, management and other key stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst your primary focus will be on retrieving, preparing, analysing, and interpreting data used throughout the validation process. You will help ensure data quality through structured DQ checks, reconciliations, and standardised datasets, while contributing to consistent data definitions, metadata management, and well‑documented data usage. Alongside analytical work, you will support the development of validation infrastructure by contributing to automation, reusable functions, reporting templates, and coding standards. You’ll be empowered to introduce new validation tools or enhance existing ones, driving innovation and efficiency. Work will be organized in small, project-driven sub-teams within a fast-paced and supportive environment that fosters creativity, autonomy, and professional growth.

The team is located in Vilnius, but you will work in close interaction with the experienced professionals in SEB Group CRO organization across Nordic and Baltic countries.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst, you will be responsible for:


Developing methodologies and advanced tools to improve model review process
Build, maintain and standardize validation datasets ensuring consistent variable definitions and filters across portfolios. Support validation sample preparation under time constraints.
Design and implement automated DQ checks, reconciliations, and data profiling tools, detect data issues early and propose fixes or compensating controls.
Document and maintain data lineage, access methods, and usage guidelines.
Develop or enhance reusable R/SQL/SAS/Python functions, templates.
Automate the generation of charts, tables, and other outputs, and ensure the seamless integration of results into standardized reporting interface.
Maintain code quality via coding standards, version control, documentation, and reproducibility practices.


Who we are looking for:


An academic background in statistics, mathematics, data science, econometrics, physics, engineering or similar
3 and more year's work experience in data analysis or credit risk modelling/validation
Good statistical/programming knowledge (R, SAS, SQL, Python) and data handling skills
Hands‑on experience with large datasets, data warehouses.
Ability to design or maintain DQ frameworks, reconciliation logic, and standardized data structures.
Familiarity with integrating analytical tool outputs into structured reports.
Willingness to take on ownership and to deliver good quality work on time
Analytical and strategic mindset with the ability to transform theory into concrete action while maintaining documentation and coding standards.
Proactive and constructive team player, ready to share experience and ideas.
Good writing and communication skills (English is the main working language).


What we offer:


Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: international working environment, empowering culture, friendly and welcoming teammates.
Growth culture: opportunity to grow professionally by contributing to large-scale, high-impact initiatives, local and international internal mobility possibilities, put an impact on social or environmental issues.
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working.
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing programme, and additional health insurance.

Title: Statistician
Description:
Abbott in Ireland

Operating since 1946, Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products. We employ around 6,000 people across ten sites in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford, and Sligo. Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal : Located in Donegal Town, our Diabetes Care division manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and sensors, including the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite, and FreeStyle Libre systems.

Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal

The Abbott Diabetes Care division based in Donegal Town manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre system.

Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company

Job Specification


Ability to independently data mine multiple large, complex datasets to answer specific research / investigation questions. Curiosity to dig deeper and access other documentation sources to understand the data.
Provide real time data analysis support to manufacturing in terms of process adjustments, material performance, investigations, programming and yield analysis.
The ability to strategically interpret statistical findings into a business significant context.
Provide consulting on data analysis and statistical tools in support of trend analysis, root cause analysis, failure investigation, risk assessment, data management and data visualization to junior team members and engineers.
Support technical investigations performed within the manufacturing unit.
Assist with the introduction of analytical test methods & development trials (analysis of variance, setting acceptance criteria & capability analysis) and support efforts to reduce measurement variability.
Work with scientists and engineers to introduce new machines, materials and processes, inputting into the design of experiments and analysis of resultant data.
Independently manages multiple projects working with stakeholders to define business questions, timelines and objectives.
Highly effective in presenting and communicating statistical results to various levels of personnel is required regularly.


Requirements :


Bachelor's Degree or higher in a quantitative field (i.e. Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Statistics, Biostatistics etc.) preferred.
Minimum of 4 years experience in a similar role.
Proficient in a programming language such as python, R, SAS, JMP or similar.
An understanding of probability, statistical process control, hypothesis testing, non-parametric statistics, time series analysis, linear and logistic regression etc.
Experience with relational databases (for example : Oracle Databases, MySQL, Microsoft Access, etc.).
