Title: Data and Reporting Analyst - Support Services
Description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com.

THE ROLE:

As a Support Services Data and Reporting Analyst, you'll help teams across Support and Operations use data to make informed decisions, improve performance and automate recurring processes. You'll work hands-on across data analysis, reporting, platform integrations and automation - gathering requirements, analysing data from multiple sources, building data models, and helping teams establish reliable metrics and structures for internal stakeholders and clients.

This role increasingly works with data held in a cloud data warehouse, using modern data-transformation practices, so SQL is essential.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


Analyse data generated by Support and Operations activities, as well as data required by other business teams, to identify trends, answer operational questions and support evidence-based decisions.
Gather, clarify and document reporting and analytics requirements from stakeholders, including account management, customers, product development and other relevant teams.
Use SQL to query, validate, combine and investigate data, primarily through the company's data warehouse.
Develop, maintain and improve dashboards, reports and analytical solutions in Sigma Computing for multiple internal and external stakeholders.
Contribute to data modelling and transformation activities.
Integrate and reconcile information from relevant systems, which may include Microsoft Power BI, Excel, Salesforce, Monday.com and warehouse data.
Automate recurring reporting and operational tasks to improve accuracy, consistency and efficiency.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write queries for data extraction, filtering, joins, aggregation and validation.
Experience in data analysis and analytics, including interpreting business requirements, investigating data and communicating useful findings.
Experience with Microsoft Power BI, plus Sigma Computing or another business-intelligence/data-visualisation platform.
Knowledge of relational databases and core data concepts, with confidence working with structured data.
Experience handling complex Excel workbooks, including advanced formulas.
Experience integrating, comparing or reconciling data from multiple sources.
Strong documentation discipline and experience applying clear, consistent analytical standards.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING


Snowflake, dbt, Python or R.
Excel macros or automation.


The monthly salary for this full-time role ranges from €2790 to €3376 gross. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

You will work Monday to Friday, 8-hour days, with a start time between 10:00 and 20:00 (for example 10:00–18:00, 11:00–19:00 or 12:00–20:00).

We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

Title: Analyst
Description:
About The Department

The Programme Management & Quality Assurance (PMQA) Unit serves as the Authority’s centralised support structure for all change and delivery initiatives. It is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving MFSA’s project management standards, ensuring consistency, transparency, and alignment across all organisational change activities. PMQA is structured around three core pillars: programme management, change management, and quality assurance. Together, these pillars provide a unified framework that supports effective planning, execution, and oversight of initiatives across the Authority.

About The Role

The Analyst will play a vital role in evaluating project data, driving governance standards, and optimizing portfolio performance. The selected candidate will be required to work with colleagues at all levels within Business and Technical departments to provide change process consultancy, training, guidance and support based on expert knowledge.

Main Responsibilities Include


Data Analysis & Reporting: Supporting in the gathering and analysis of complex project data to build executive dashboards and manage information reports;
Governance & Compliance: Supporting the monitoring of active projects for adherence to organizational frameworks, standards, and stage-gate processes;
Risk & Issue Oversight: Tracking and analysing portfolio-level RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs and escalating critical variances through the project managers;
Process Optimization: Identifying operational gaps and supporting continuous improvement initiatives;
Project Management: Supporting the respective project managers and participating in regular status meetings with stakeholders to perform timely follow-up on agreed actions;
Undertake any other duties as assigned by the Head and/or as may be required by the MFSA from time to time based on the exigencies of the Authority.


About You

The role requires an academic qualification in Business, Project Management, IT and/or Change Management or a relevant field at National Qualifications Framework (NQF) Level 6 or higher, duly certified by the Malta Qualifications Recognition Information Centre (MQRIC), or a widely recognised professional certification at an equivalent level.

Along with the aforementioned academic qualification, you should also possess a minimum of three (3) years working in a project management or change management environment, or in an area related to the role.

If you do not have the necessary academic or professional qualifications but you have at least seven (7) years of relevant experience, we would still be interested in speaking with you.

Skills And Competencies


Project Management techniques used to plan, execute, monitor and close projects effectively.
Proficiency in data manipulation (excel, SQL, PowerBI) and core PPM software (MS Project, JIRA, or similar platforms).
Capability to work on own initiative, cross-functional communication, presentation skills and conflict resolution.
Experience of working in a dynamic and high pressure environment with multiple deadlines.
Solid knowledge of the financial services industry will be beneficial.


Other Important Information

The MFSA is an Equal Opportunities Employer as certified by the NCPE (National Commission for the Protection of Equality) and is committed to a policy of equal opportunity in all aspects of employment and will take care to avoid any form of discrimination in its recruitment procedures. The MFSA reserves the right to withdraw this call at any time and not to select any of the Candidates.

It is the responsibility of applicants in possession of qualifications awarded by Universities and other similar institutions outside Malta to produce a recognition statement on comparability of qualifications issued by the Malta Qualifications Recognition Information Centre (MQRIC). Applicants should do so preferably at application stage or otherwise at the preliminary interview should an applicant be selected for such interview. Details can be obtained by accessing the National Commission for Further and Higher Education website on www.ncfhe.gov.mt under MQRIC heading.

The MFSA shall ensure that any processing of personal data is in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation), the Data Protection Act (Chapter 586 of the Laws of Malta) and any other relevant European Union and national law. For further details, you may refer to the Data Protection Policy on the MFSA webpage www.mfsa.mt. Candidates are to note that the submission of any false statement/s or omission, even if unintended, may lead to the cancellation of their application and may render the candidate's appointment liable to termination.

Furthermore, please note that candidates may be asked to submit any documentation in support of the information provided, including but not limited to, proof of qualifications and Police Conduct Certificates.

Title: Process Analyst
Description:
About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Process Analyst to work as the data and analytics interface for Kerry’s Enzyme Process Technology (PT) Team. Embedded within the wider PT team, over three production sites, the role will focus on curating, structuring, analysing, and visualising process data across the entirety of the microbial enzyme production life cycle.

The successful candidate will partner closely with the PT teams on site to curate, structure and visualise manufacturing and process data from Kerry’s core systems (including SAP, EPM/MES platforms, SCADA systems and local Excel based datasets), turning complex and fragmented data streams into clear insights that support yield, recovery, productivity, process robustness and facilitate operational excellence.

Key responsibilities

Data Curation & Integration


  Extract, clean and harmonise process and manufacturing data from
  SAP (process orders, batch data, confirmations, material movements, yields)
  EPM / MES / LIMS / SCADA systems
  Site level Excel trackers and historical datasets
  Resolve inconsistencies between system data and off-line data repositories
  Improve transparency and traceability of process performance data
  Understand how SAP master data structures influence process orders, confirmations, yields, and performance reporting


Process & Manufacturing Analytics


  Analyse and trend process performance data across the end-to-end enzyme production process, including Inoculum preparation and cultivation; Fermentation metrics and profiles; and Downstream operational parameters and yields
  Support PT with robust analysis of key performance indices including yield and rolled throughput yield; recovery of unit operations; Enzyme titre and productivity; Losses, variability and deviation impacts
  Provide analytical support to process optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement projects
  Work with PAT and IoT-enabled sensors, historians, and data acquisition systems to contextualise high-frequency process data alongside batch and transactional datasets


Data Architecture


  Design and implement practical data frameworks and architecture to improve data accessibility and data reliability
  Reduce manual data handling by improving integration between SAP and reporting tools, while standardising data flows and calculation logic
  Work with each respective production site to align on data architecture and tools
  Clearly document datasets, assumptions and calculations used in PT reporting


Visualisation & Reporting


  Translate complex, multivariate datasets into clear, decision focused visuals, using Power BI dashboards for site, Excel based tools, PowerPoint etc
  Develop standardised visual and reporting templates to illustrate end-to-end process data


Collaboration within Process Technology


  Operate as a core member of the Process Technology team to help improve transparency and accessible to process data
  Leverage expertise from the PT teams to interpret biological data and benchmark expected process outcomes
  Work with the wide team to help coordinate how data may be collected, stored and modelled from operational process data and equipment


Qualifications and skills


  Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Science, Biotechnology, or related field with a MSc or PhD preferred
  Experience applying data engineering principles (data pipelines, transformations, data quality controls) in a manufacturing or process environment with complex and various data streams
  Solid industrial process/data analytics experience, operating at a moderate to advanced level
  Advanced capability in Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint and other related platforms is a necessity
  Experience in working with SAP and managing its datasets is a strong advantage
  A proven understanding of data modelling, architecture and scalable analytical frameworks
  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work within multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders
  Advanced English proficiency


Why Kerry?

In Kerry we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles, and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.

Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kerry and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.

Please note We do not accept CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies where Kerry terms of business have not been signed. Additionally, we will not consider or agree to payment of any recruiter fee under these circumstances. This also applies to CVs or candidate profiles sent directly to any Kerry Hiring Managers.

Title: DUOMENŲ ANALITIKĖ (-AS)
HTML:
Ar nori tapti „Ignitis Group“ dalimi?

Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) duomenų analitikos komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už analizę, elektros energijos prekybai vykdyti. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:


  • Kuriant IT ir analitinius įrankius duomenų gavimui, analizei, procesų optimizavimui, procesų stebėsenai ir automatizacijai;
  • Analizuojant kaip tikslinti duomenų prognozes;
  • Inicijuojant, diegiant ir tobulinant naujus analizės modelius;
  • Kuriant įrankius kitiems įmonės specialistams, ruošiant ataskaitas savarankiškai;
  • Vykdant didmeninės rinkos modeliavimą;
  • Rengiant įvairias nestandartines analizes;
  • Tobulinant ir administruojant automatinės prekybos sistemas;
  • Reguliariai besidomint naujausiomis duomenų analizės srities tendencijomis.


Šiai pozicijai svarbu:


  • Aukštasis universitetinis išsilavinimas (ekonometrijos, statistikos, matematikos ar kitų panašių tiksliųjų mokslo srityse);
  • Programavimo patirtis ir geras išmanymas „SQL“ ir „Python“ bei makrokomandų kūrimas „MS Excel“, „Power Query“, „VBA“
  • Sugebėjimas naudoti vizualizacijos įrankius, pvz., „Power BI“, ir kurti aiškias, suprantamas ir efektyvias duomenų vizualizacijas.
  • Didelių duomenų („big data“) technologijų supratimas.
  • Duomenų integracinių („API“) sprendimų supratimas, gebėjimas konfigūruoti ir jų programavimas.
  • Elektros rinkos veikimo principų išmanymas;
  • Analitinis mąstymas, duomenų raštingumas, geri problemų sprendimo įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas vizualiai ir aiškiai pateikti apibendrintą informaciją ir analitines įžvalgas.


Privalumas būtų:


  • Ankstesnė prekybos patirtis elektros / kitų žaliavų / akcijų / valiutų biržoje;
  • Su energetika susijusių duomenų dalinimosi platformų išmanymas;
  • Darbo vieta: Kruonis/Kaunas.


Mainais už tvaresnės ateities kūrimą, mes pažadame:


  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Skani dienos dalis: pusė pietų kainos padengiama įmonės, o kava ir vaisiai visada po ranka;
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms;
  • Įvairovę ir įtrauktį puoselėjančią darbo kultūrą;
  • Papildomą skatinimą dalyvaujant Grupės iniciatyvose.


Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Pareigybių grupės pastovios atlyginimo dalies intervalas: yra nuo 2770 iki 4150 EUR (neatskaičius mokesčių). Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį ir kompetenciją. Prie darbo užmokesčio gali būti mokama kintamoji atlygio dalis.

Apie mus:

Norėtum prisidėti prie projektų, užtikrinančių energetinį saugumą mūsų namams? „Ignitis grupė“, kurios svarbią dalį sudaro „Ignitis gamyba“, yra Baltijos šalyse pirmaujanti integruota energetikos įmonių grupė. Pagrindinis mūsų siekis yra sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

„Ignitis gamyba“ valdo ir plėtoja didžiausius elektros energijos gamybos pajėgumus Lietuvoje. Elektrėnų kompleksas, didžiausia atsinaujinančius energijos išteklius gaminanti elektrinė Lietuvoje – Kauno hidroelektrinė, bei vienintelė tokio tipo elektrinė Baltijos šalyse – Kruonio hidroakumuliacinė elektrinė, padeda užtikrinti šalies energetikos sistemų saugumą ir patikimumą.

www.ignitisgamyba.lt

Title: Casino Promotions Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Casino Promotions Analyst with strong casino industry knowledge and a solid background in analytics, mathematics and data interpretation.




The Casino Promotions Analyst will be responsible for evaluating the monthly promotional activities arranged by the Account Management team. The role will analyze promotional performance, extract and interpret relevant data, and provide clear reporting on the commercial effectiveness of each promotion.

The objective is to move promotional decisions toward a data-driven approach, identifying which games, mechanics and promotional strategies generate the strongest results for specific clients, player groups and markets.




Key Responsibilities:

Review and evaluate monthly casino promotions arranged by Account Managers.
Extract, organize and analyze data relating to promotional performance.
Measure the effectiveness and commercial benefit of individual promotions.
Produce clear monthly reports showing results, trends, strengths and areas for improvement.
Analyze which casino games and game categories perform best within promotions.
Identify which promotional mechanics generate the strongest player engagement and commercial results.
Compare promotional performance across different clients, markets and player segments.
Determine which types of promotions are most effective for specific clients and markets.
Analyze historical promotional data to identify recurring patterns and performance trends.
Evaluate whether promotional activity is producing sufficient value relative to its cost and commercial objectives.
Provide Account Managers with data-backed recommendations for future promotions.
Identify underperforming promotions and provide recommendations on how they can be improved.
Help develop a more structured approach to promotion planning based on previous results rather than assumptions.
Maintain accurate records and reporting that allow promotional performance to be compared month over month.
Work closely with Account Management and other relevant teams to improve the overall effectiveness of casino promotional campaigns.




Requirements:

Strong understanding of the online casino / iGaming industry.
Good knowledge of casino games, player behavior and promotional mechanics.
Strong analytical and mathematical background.
Excellent ability to interpret numerical data and translate it into practical commercial recommendations.
Experience working with datasets, reporting tools and spreadsheets.
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with BI or data visualization tools is an advantage.
Ability to identify patterns, correlations and performance trends.
Commercial mindset with an understanding of how promotions influence player activity, game performance and revenue.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical teams.
Previous experience in casino analytics, gaming analytics, promotions, CRM, BI or a similar analytical role is highly desirable.




Key Focus of the Role:

The role combines casino knowledge, mathematics, data analytics and commercial understanding to ensure promotional decisions are supported by measurable results.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
HTML:
As a Quantitative Analyst, you will support power price and production forecast unit for math, optimization and in-depth data related tasks.

In this role, you will:

  • develop, maintain and continuously improve core forecasting, simulation and decision support solutions;
  • design and implement tools for forecasting, and operational planning;
  • contribute to quantitative models, algorithmic solutions, data processing workflows, and system automation initiatives across multiple business domains;
  • handle and process weather-related datasets, including gridded data sources;
  • integrate weather-related models and data streams into systems;
  • develop and maintain renewable asset forecasting solutions at both the individual asset and portfolio levels;
  • prepare, update, and maintain technical documentation and presentation materials;
  • validate and backtest models, identify improvement opportunities, and collaborate with data engineers to implement enhancements;
  • contribute to cross-functional projects and other ad hoc data, modelling, and analytics initiatives.

With us, you can:

  • develop professionally through continuous training and development programs that expand your skills and experience;
  • opportunity for long-term career growth and self-fulfillment in a growing international company;
  • enjoy 5 additional vacation days after your first year;
  • choose a well‑being package that suits you, including health insurance and/or Stebby services.

You are a great match if you:

  • have work experience in the fields of Data Analysis, Data Science, or Quantitative Analysis;
  • have strong analytical and data-related skills, including developing complex prediction models, solving optimization problems, automating, and handling large volumes of data;
  • are experienced in either R or Python, complemented by a basic familiarity with the other;
  • are familiar with data workflows, including data storage, access, and transformation (SQL, data import/export, and Parquet files);
  • are a results-oriented team player with an eagerness to learn;
  • hold a university degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field;
  • speak fluent English.

Title: Web Analyst

Analyze and optimize dataLayer coverage and structure to ensure robust, scalable data collection
Create and implement measurement strategies perfectly aligned with business goals, defining custom dimensions, metrics, and advanced event tracking

Apply familiarity with modern marketing and tracking practices to safely implement, troubleshoot, and thoroughly test tracking scripts
Partner with marketing, product, and development teams to promote data-driven decision-making and ensure tracking specs are met
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on data analysis and segmentation; support A/B testing initiatives where relevant
Contribute to broader business insights analysis, working alongside the analytics team to connect web data to wider business performance questions
Keep up-to-date with the latest privacy regulations, GA4 features, and analytics best practices

Demonstrated experience setting up, maintaining, reviewing, and optimizing complex Google Tag Manager and GA4 environments
Strong understanding of dataLayer architecture, including the ability to analyze coverage gaps and guide developers on optimization
Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to leverage the full suite of GA4 functionalities to answer complex business questions

Strong SQL skills for querying and analyzing raw GA4 export data
Excellent communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English - capable of translating intricate tracking setups and raw data into clear, stakeholder-friendly insight

Familiarity with iGaming metrics and KPIs
Experience working with Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Google Data Studio / Looker Studio for creating automated, dynamic dashboards
Familiarity with Google Search Console (GSC) to connect search performance with on-site user behavior
Sufficient knowledge of A/B testing and CRO methodologies to support other roles with advanced data validation and analysis
Solid understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and how they impact tracking and DOM scraping
Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager certifications

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights.


Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)

Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features.
Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across the business.
Unlocking new layers of payment performance, from uncovering new fraud vectors to maximizing success rates
Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.


What Excites Us


You have a background working in similar fast paced product-driven teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed product decisions
You are a self-starter, focused on results, with a demonstrated background in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of a product
You have extensive experience with data visualisation tools mentioned above and develop compelling visualisations which influence decision making and business understanding
You have advanced SQL skills and intermediate Python skills & have experience leveraging AI capabilities to enhance data analysis, automate tasks, and improve decision-making processes
You have a background working in similar fast paced teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed decisions.
You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across the business and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!


Salary range: the expected base salary range for this position is between €32,000 - €48,000.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff


Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.




Blockchain.com is looking for a Business Analyst to support strategic products, markets, and customer segments within the Consumer business.

This is a high-impact analytical and product-oriented role focused on business performance, growth opportunities, customer insights, product execution, and operational excellence. You will work closely with Business Leads, Product, Engineering, Trading, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, Finance, and Regional teams to help identify opportunities, shape product priorities, build business cases, track performance, and support the launch of new initiatives.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Support the strategy, roadmap, and commercial performance of key business areas within Consumer.
Analyze business performance across users, activity, revenue, margin, retention, volume, conversion, and P&L.
Work with Business Leads and Product Managers to identify product opportunities, define problem statements, and support prioritization.
Translate business goals, customer insights, and data analysis into clear product recommendations.
Build dashboards, reports, and analysis to help teams understand performance, diagnose issues, and identify opportunities.
Support business cases for new products, features, markets, or customer propositions, including market size, customer demand, economics, operational requirements, and risk.
Partner with Product and Engineering to help define requirements, clarify trade-offs, and support delivery of customer-facing features.
Support product launches by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Marketing, CRM, Growth, Compliance, Operations, and Regional teams.
Work with Trading, Treasury, Risk, Finance, and Compliance to analyze pricing, economics, risk controls, and profitability.
Track competitors, customer behavior, and market trends to identify opportunities to differentiate and win share.
Help establish a clear operating cadence around performance tracking, experimentation, launches, product reviews, and business reviews.




WHAT YOU WILL NEED

Experience in business analysis, product analytics, product operations, strategy, growth, fintech, crypto, payments, consulting, or consumer technology.
Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data, business modeling, funnels, unit economics, pricing, conversion, retention, and profitability.
Ability to turn data, customer insights, and business problems into clear product recommendations.
Strong product judgment and strong interest in building customer-facing products.
Ability to work closely with Product and Engineering teams, including helping define requirements, prioritize opportunities, and support execution.
Strong communication skills and ability to present findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
High ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to work across both strategic analysis and hands-on product execution.
Interest in crypto, fintech, consumer products, and high-growth businesses.




COMPENSATION & PERKS

Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.
Unlimited books policy; order the technical resources you need or simply pick something up from our company library.
Apple equipment.
Learning and development opportunities in other areas than AML in the future.
Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company.
Role based in our Malta office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Title: Quantitative Data Analyst in Credit Risk Model Validation | SEB, Vilnius
Description:
SEB is a leading northern European financial services group with a high focus on risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and governance. Banking is transforming at pace, our talented and rapidly expanding quant team is committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a strong risk culture. Does that sound like a fit for you?

What You Will Be Doing

You will be a part of a professional team within SEB Group CRO organization that ensures quality of models used for measuring credit risk. We conduct in-depth reviews of the models to ensure quality performance by assessing model design and modelling methodologies, performance from the statistical point of view, data quality, implementation, regulatory compliance, and usage.

We work closely with model developers, owners, users, management and other key stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst your primary focus will be on retrieving, preparing, analysing, and interpreting data used throughout the validation process. You will help ensure data quality through structured DQ checks, reconciliations, and standardised datasets, while contributing to consistent data definitions, metadata management, and well‑documented data usage. Alongside analytical work, you will support the development of validation infrastructure by contributing to automation, reusable functions, reporting templates, and coding standards. You’ll be empowered to introduce new validation tools or enhance existing ones, driving innovation and efficiency. Work will be organized in small, project-driven sub-teams within a fast-paced and supportive environment that fosters creativity, autonomy, and professional growth.

The team is located in Vilnius, but you will work in close interaction with the experienced professionals in SEB Group CRO organization across Nordic and Baltic countries.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst, you will be responsible for:


Developing methodologies and advanced tools to improve model review process
Build, maintain and standardize validation datasets ensuring consistent variable definitions and filters across portfolios. Support validation sample preparation under time constraints.
Design and implement automated DQ checks, reconciliations, and data profiling tools, detect data issues early and propose fixes or compensating controls.
Document and maintain data lineage, access methods, and usage guidelines.
Develop or enhance reusable R/SQL/SAS/Python functions, templates.
Automate the generation of charts, tables, and other outputs, and ensure the seamless integration of results into standardized reporting interface.
Maintain code quality via coding standards, version control, documentation, and reproducibility practices.


Who we are looking for:


An academic background in statistics, mathematics, data science, econometrics, physics, engineering or similar
3 and more year's work experience in data analysis or credit risk modelling/validation
Good statistical/programming knowledge (R, SAS, SQL, Python) and data handling skills
Hands‑on experience with large datasets, data warehouses.
Ability to design or maintain DQ frameworks, reconciliation logic, and standardized data structures.
Familiarity with integrating analytical tool outputs into structured reports.
Willingness to take on ownership and to deliver good quality work on time
Analytical and strategic mindset with the ability to transform theory into concrete action while maintaining documentation and coding standards.
Proactive and constructive team player, ready to share experience and ideas.
Good writing and communication skills (English is the main working language).


What we offer:


Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: international working environment, empowering culture, friendly and welcoming teammates.
Growth culture: opportunity to grow professionally by contributing to large-scale, high-impact initiatives, local and international internal mobility possibilities, put an impact on social or environmental issues.
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working.
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing programme, and additional health insurance.


Do you want to be a part of SEB?

Welcome to join our inspiring culture and dedicated team of 1700 professionals. Our office offers both work and leisure areas, including a gym, library, game room, roof terrace, and more.

Click here to read all about it: https://www.seb.lt/en/gs

We are looking forward to your application by September 09, 2026.

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application before the deadline.

Learn more about working at SEB here: https://sebgroup.com/career

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!

Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.

Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis. Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
Strategic Support and Analysis. Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC/FinCrime function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.

KPI Implementation and Target Setting. Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.

Quantitative Foundation. Ideally, you have a background in statistics, maths, physics, engineering, economics, or another scientific field. You apply first-principles thinking to break down complex operational problems.
A Statistical Mindset. You have a natural grasp of data logic. You don't just look at averages; you understand distributions, variance, and significance. You enjoy applying that rigor to messy, real-world operational data to separate signal from noise.
You have 4+ years of experience in analytics with demonstrated ability to approach complex problems with a strategic mindset, identifying innovative solutions that drive operational improvements.
You have a background working with operational team analytics including capacity planning, forecasting, efficiency analysis, quality assurance, predictive analytics, and experimentation.
You have experience working with complex data models in SQL (our warehouse is Snowflake) and analysing it using advanced SQL/Python/R
Able to demonstrate that you can tell a story and proactively give guidance on strategy based on insights
You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate storytelling ability with data
You have a bias to action - you identify what needs to be done and make it happen.


Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)


Prior experience in Operation domains
You have experience working with a WFM or Quality team.
You have experience working with WFM Systems
You have experience with forecasting techniques such as ARIMA, Holt-Winters, and other time series analysis methods

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Help Shape the Future of Data-Driven Insurance

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an innovative centre of excellence established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. Our mission is to unlock the power of data, delivering actionable insights that support colleagues, clients and insurer partners across a global insurance network of more than 12,000 professionals.

By combining advanced analytics, business intelligence and deep industry expertise, we help organisations better understand risk, predict future outcomes and make smarter decisions in an increasingly complex world.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a talented Business Intelligence Specialist to join our Business Intelligence team. This is an exciting opportunity for a data-driven professional who is passionate about transforming complex information into meaningful insights through world-class reporting and visualisation solutions.

The Opportunity

As a Business Intelligence Specialist, you will design, develop and optimise Power BI reporting solutions that enable business leaders to make informed decisions with confidence. Working at the intersection of data, technology, design and business strategy, you'll create trusted dashboards, semantic models and reporting assets that support key stakeholders across The Ardonagh Group.

You will play a key role in shaping how data is consumed across the organisation while working with modern Microsoft technologies, including Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting & Dashboard Development


Design and develop intuitive, visually engaging, high-performing Power BI dashboards and reports.
Translate business requirements, KPIs and stakeholder needs into impactful reporting solutions.
Create drill-through experiences, interactive visuals, filters and navigation features that enhance user experience.
Partner with UX/UI colleagues to apply established branding, design standards and best practices.


Data Modelling & Analytics


Design, maintain and optimise Power BI semantic models.
Develop robust DAX measures and calculations using industry best practices.
Ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable and easy to maintain.
Analyse and improve dashboard performance, load times and model efficiency.


Microsoft Fabric & Governance


Work within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Service environments, supporting workspaces, datasets, deployments and refresh processes.
Implement security controls including workspace permissions, audience management and Row-Level Security (RLS).
Support controlled deployment and governance practices across reporting environments.


Documentation & Support


Produce clear documentation covering dashboards, semantic models, data sources and business logic.
Support UAT processes, change requests and post-implementation enhancements.
Monitor reporting operations, refresh schedules and user access requests.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Analytics Lab.


About You

You'll be a technically strong BI professional with a passion for delivering solutions that create real business value. You'll be comfortable working with multiple stakeholders, translating complex requirements into intuitive reporting experiences and balancing project delivery with ongoing support activities.

Essential

Skills & Experience


Proven experience developing and supporting Power BI solutions in a commercial environment.
Strong expertise in:
Power BI Desktop
Power BI Service
DAX
Power Query
T-SQL
Semantic data modelling
Dashboard performance optimisation
Advanced T-SQL development experience, including:
CTEs
Window functions
Temporary tables
Table-valued functions
Complex query design and optimisation
Stored procedures and SQL views
Experience translating business requirements into scalable BI and reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling, reporting layers and data platform concepts.
Experience managing stakeholder relationships and competing priorities.

Desirable


Experience working with Microsoft Fabric.
Knowledge of Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Spark notebooks.
Understanding of data ingestion, transformation and orchestration processes.
Exposure to metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable data platform architectures.
Experience within insurance, financial services or a data analytics function.


What We're Looking For

We're Seeking Someone Who Is

✅ Detail-oriented and quality-focused

✅ Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams

✅ Passionate about turning data into business value

✅ A strong communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

✅ Proactive in identifying improvements and solving problems

Why Join Ardonagh Analytics Lab?

At Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll work with cutting-edge technology, complex and meaningful data sets, and a highly collaborative team committed to innovation. You'll have the opportunity to influence decision-making across a global organisation while developing your expertise in one of the most exciting areas of modern analytics.

If you're ready to help shape the future of data-driven insurance, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and be part of something bigger at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

If you approach life with a sense of adventure you might just find what you need at Ardonagh to bring your ambition to life.

Find out more about Ardonagh’s world of opportunity on LinkedIn or visit www.ardonagh.com.

Advanced knowledge of SQL at the level of complex queries;
Data visualization skills, proficiency with BI instruments (we use Tableau);
Good mathematical knowledge and knowledge of statistics;
Knowledge of Python popular libraries for data processing and analysis;
Experienced in working with DWH, overall understanding of DWH design and operations;
Written and spoken English (B2 and higher).

Experience in game development (2+ years) and understanding of game production processes and needs;

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Help Shape the Future of Data-Driven Insurance

The Ardonagh Analytics Lab is an innovative centre of excellence established by The Ardonagh Group in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. Our mission is to unlock the power of data, delivering actionable insights that support colleagues, clients and insurer partners across a global insurance network of more than 12,000 professionals.

By combining advanced analytics, business intelligence and deep industry expertise, we help organisations better understand risk, predict future outcomes and make smarter decisions in an increasingly complex world.

The Opportunity

As a Business Intelligence Specialist, you will design, develop and optimise Power BI reporting solutions that enable business leaders to make informed decisions with confidence. What You'll Be Doing

Reporting & Dashboard Development


Design and develop intuitive, visually engaging, high-performing Power BI dashboards and reports.
Translate business requirements, KPIs and stakeholder needs into impactful reporting solutions.

Partner with UX/UI colleagues to apply established branding, design standards and best practices.


Data Modelling & Analytics

Ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable and easy to maintain.
Analyse and improve dashboard performance, load times and model efficiency.


Microsoft Fabric & Governance


Work within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Service environments, supporting workspaces, datasets, deployments and refresh processes.
Implement security controls including workspace permissions, audience management and Row-Level Security (RLS).
Support controlled deployment and governance practices across reporting environments.


Documentation & Support


Produce clear documentation covering dashboards, semantic models, data sources and business logic.
Support UAT processes, change requests and post-implementation enhancements.
Monitor reporting operations, refresh schedules and user access requests.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Analytics Lab.


About You

You'll be a technically strong BI professional with a passion for delivering solutions that create real business value. You'll be comfortable working with multiple stakeholders, translating complex requirements into intuitive reporting experiences and balancing project delivery with ongoing support activities.

Essential

Skills & Experience


Proven experience developing and supporting Power BI solutions in a commercial environment.
Strong expertise in:
Power BI Desktop
Power BI Service
DAX
Power Query
T-SQL
Semantic data modelling
Dashboard performance optimisation
Advanced T-SQL development experience, including:
CTEs
Window functions
Temporary tables
Table-valued functions
Complex query design and optimisation
Stored procedures and SQL views
Experience translating business requirements into scalable BI and reporting solutions.
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling, reporting layers and data platform concepts.
Experience managing stakeholder relationships and competing priorities.

Desirable


Experience working with Microsoft Fabric.
Knowledge of Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Spark notebooks.
Understanding of data ingestion, transformation and orchestration processes.
Exposure to metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable data platform architectures.
Experience within insurance, financial services or a data analytics function.


What We're Looking For

We're seeking someone who is:

✅ Detail-oriented and quality-focused

✅ Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams

✅ Passionate about turning data into business value

✅ A strong communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

✅ Proactive in identifying improvements and solving problems

Why Join Ardonagh Analytics Lab?

At Ardonagh Analytics Lab, you'll work with cutting-edge technology, complex and meaningful data sets, and a highly collaborative team committed to innovation. You'll have the opportunity to influence decision-making across a global organisation while developing your expertise in one of the most exciting areas of modern analytics.

If you're ready to help shape the future of data-driven insurance, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and be part of something bigger at The Ardonagh Group.

The Company

In an industry that never stands still, neither do we. The Ardonagh Group was founded in 2017 and has grown to become the UK’s largest independent insurance distribution platform and a top 20 broker globally.

Our best-in-class entrepreneurial and specialist brands span a network of 150+ locations worldwide and have a combined workforce of more than c.12,000 people. Across our portfolio, we offer a highly diversified range of insurance-related products and services across the full insurance value chain in the UK, Ireland and broader international markets.

From complex multinational corporations to individuals purchasing personal insurance policies, our understanding of the communities we serve, together with our scale and breadth, allows us to deliver a broad range of product and risk solutions to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving market.

Investigate and resolve data issues such as discrepancies, missing information, and quality gaps.
Prepare forecasts, perform ad‑hoc analyses, and present insights to stakeholders while supporting data‑driven decision‑making.

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.
2–3 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics, or a similar field.

Result oriented mindset, independence, and strong collaboration skills across departments.

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Financial Data Analyst (Reconciliation, Reporting & FP&A)

Riga

Hybrid: up to 2 remote working days weekly




We are looking for a finance-minded Financial Data Analyst with strong financial planning and analysis experience to join our dynamic team in our vibrant office in Riga.

In this global role, you will combine ownership of our client-book reconciliation process with hands-on support for budgeting, forecasting and performance management. You will work closely with Finance and department heads across the business to ensure data integrity, accurate financial reporting, robust planning inputs, and clear visibility of performance against budget.




Your analytical mindset and understanding of accounting logic and financial data flows will help to identify discrepancies, trace their root causes and design efficient solutions.

Beyond reconciliation work, you’ll use your technical skills in SQL, databases, Power BI and Excel to automate processes, build insightful dashboards, prepare budgets and forecasts, and turn budget-versus-actual performance into practical insight for business decision-making.




Our mission

3S Money is reinventing international business banking. Founded in 2018, our mission is to help growing businesses send, receive and exchange money in over 190 countries. With offices in five countries and over 180 employees, you’ll be joining a high-energy, high-impact team that’s achieved profitability and has a wealth of opportunity ahead.




Our culture

At 3S Money, we believe in caring personally, staying curious and making an impact through collaboration not competition. Our culture is genuinely transparent with minimal hierarchy and a commitment to each employee’s professional growth.




Our team

We're a team driven by data, financial insight and collaboration, and we're looking for someone who can connect detailed financial information with the wider commercial picture.

If you enjoy improving financial processes, working with department heads on budgets and forecasts, and turning variances into meaningful insight that shapes business decisions, we’d love to meet you!




What you’ll be doing

· Take end‑to‑end ownership of the client‑book reconciliation process, including running reconciliations, analysing and resolving discrepancies across multiple systems

· Maintain and enhance reconciliation reporting in Power BI, including investigating reconciliation breaks across Power BI, source systems, and underlying datasets to identify root causes and fixes where required.

· Support the automation of reconciliation workflows in close collaboration with Finance, Settlements, and Operations teams.

· Analyse operational and financial data, support ad-hoc reporting and analytical requests, and contribute to improvements in data quality, reporting accuracy, and reporting processes.

· Support Finance and Operations teams with reporting, and ad-hoc data requests, ensuring timely follow-up, resolution, and escalation where required.

· Prepare budget forecasts and periodic re-forecasts, working with Finance to consolidate, validate and challenge inputs across departments.

· Help manage the annual and periodic budgeting process, liaising with department heads and other key stakeholders to gather, challenge and align budget assumptions.

· Prepare regular budget-versus-actual analysis, investigate material variances, and explain the key drivers of performance to Finance and relevant department heads.

· Partner with department heads to monitor performance against budget, identify risks and opportunities early, and agree actions to keep plans on track.

· Support business decisions by assessing their financial impact and helping stakeholders ensure that proposed actions are consistent with approved budgets and forecasts.




About you, you have

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in an FP&A, finance, accounting, audit or data-related role, with meaningful involvement in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and financial analysis.

• Hands-on experience analysing budget-versus-actual variances, presenting results in a clear, structured way and ability to translate analysis into practical actions.

• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial concepts, including confidence working with ledgers, balances, and transaction flows.

• Practical experience with Power BI for maintaining and supporting operational and financial reporting.

• Comfortable working with SQL and Microsoft Excel for analysing, validating, and reconciling data.

• Experience - or strong interest - in automating repeatable reporting or reconciliation processes, including exposure to Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools.

• Experience working with business stakeholders to collect requirements, clarify ambiguous needs, and translate them into structured reporting or data solutions.

• Comfortable working independently in execution: able to drive analysis, structure problems, and move work forward without step-by-step guidance.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Federal Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply


Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:


Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K
