Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Position Summary

Odyssey Systems has an exciting opportunity for a Journeyman Data Business Analyst supporting the NC3 Contract, specifically the GASNTi1 & GASNTi2 program offices within the Nuclear Networks Division (NCN). The AFNWC/NC3 Integration Directorate is headquartered at Hanscom Air Force Base, MA.

This is a full-time position located at Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts.

Responsibilities

In this Advisory and Assistance Services (A&AS) role, the Data Business Analyst will provide analytical and data-driven support to Department of Defense (DoD) programs. The role supports government leadership by applying data analysis, visualization, and business intelligence techniques to inform program, financial, and acquisition decision-making in support of mission objectives.

Duties Include, But Are Not Limited To:


Use business intelligence data for predictive analytics and implementation of data visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik Sense, PMRT, and Power BI
Administer quantitative and qualitative modeling techniques using Microsoft Excel and data visualization platforms including Tableau, Qlik Sense, PMRT, and Power BI
Apply analytical best practices for data collection, aggregation, normalization, and analysis
Analyze and process data while creating and maintaining models and report templates
Develop dynamic, data-driven solutions using data engineering tools such as Databricks or low-code/no-code platforms including Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse
Recommend and implement performance measures including efficiency metrics and statistical indicators
Provide customers with detailed, actionable reports documenting findings to support program management, financial management, and acquisition activities


Qualifications

Must be a US citizen

Minimum Required Qualifications

Clearance: Must have and maintain a Secret clearance

Education: BA/BS in a related discipline

Experience:


3+ years of experience in data visualization, data management, data governance, data strategy, data policy, or data engineering
2+ years of experience designing, creating, and maintaining analytics and visualization platforms using Tableau and Power BI
2+ years of experience engaging with clients, gathering requirements, and implementing analytics or visualization solutions
Experience querying and analyzing data to answer questions and solve problems
Experience visualizing data to communicate key insights
Knowledge of business analysis or business intelligence tools and methodologies
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to evolving organizational processes


Preferred Qualifications Education: MA/MS in an analytical field

Experience:


3–10 years of relevant experience
Experience with Microsoft Power Query, Databricks, or SQL for data engineering
Experience developing applications using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse
Ability to synthesize analytical results and deliver briefings or presentations to product owners and stakeholders


Location: Hanscom Air Force Base, MA

Travel: Occasional travel based on program needs

On-site

Company Overview

Odyssey is a world-class technical, engineering, and integration company serving the warfighting ecosystem with airborne integration, ISR, C2, and warfighter readiness capabilities. Odyssey meets the military’s operational needs by integrating layered defense systems from equipment, technology, and services to data, information, and business operations. We streamline defense acquisition and sustainment, engineering the technical battlefield with domain-specific proficiency to ensure lethality. Odyssey is dedicated to excellent contract execution, peak organizational performance, and fostering a workplace built on employee care.

Odyssey is proud to live out our core values of commitment, ambition, and respect in our work and communities through OdysseyCares , a philanthropic group focused on giving back through direct donations, an employer match program, and volunteering events.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals With Disabilities

Please Note:

Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as the Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, geographic location, education, and certifications.

This position is filled through continuous recruitment and will remain open until a sufficient pool of applications has been received.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, Tricare supplement, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employee assistance program, learning and development benefit, paid time off, and holidays.

Title: Analyst II, GTM Analytics & BI
Description:
Meet Our Team


PLEASE NOTE: We are currently considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Waltham office and those who wouldn't require sponsorship now or in the future.***


Our team stands at the forefront of data analytics, leveraging cutting-edge technology including generative AI to create sophisticated data products. We are passionate about driving data driven decisions and scaling our business that leads to positive business outcomes. We’ve built relationships as trusted business partners to our stakeholders and are constantly looking for ways to improve how we work and look at our business. The team is highly collaborative within Pega and a team first approach. We work with a high sense of excellence and urgency to deliver the best possible work product to drive results. The team values collaboration, learning, and mentorship, and provides a strong environment for analysts to grow their skills and impact.

Picture Yourself At Pega

You will be part of a highly innovative company, changing how companies work and optimizing their outcomes. In this role you will be part of a collaborative team that is well versed and skilled in their space. You will be an adaptive/flexible change agent driving data driven decisioning while seeing the benefits of your hard work turn into business outcomes. You'll work alongside high-performing team members who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with data analytics and AI.

What You'll Do At Pega

The Go-to-Market Analytics and Insights Analyst II will partner with other internal team members, as well as partners across the Go-to-Market function. This role will be a key business partner to these teams by building and maintaining data products to support actionable insights that help drive optimal business outcomes. You will contribute to ongoing analytics initiatives, help ensure data quality and consistency, and look for opportunities to improve how data is delivered and used across the business.

In This Role You Will


Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical data products used by GTM teams
Ensure data products deliver accurate, consistent, and actionable insights aligned to standardized KPI definitions and data models
Apply best practices in data visualization, performance optimization, and reporting design to improve usability and adoption
Contribute to the development and enhancement of data products that improve efficiency and support decision-making
Partner with stakeholders and team members to translate business needs into reporting and analytical outputs
Perform ad hoc analyses to uncover insights and support business performance
Contribute to the design and evolution of scalable analytical solutions and reporting approaches
Define requirements, logic, and structure for dashboards and analyses with guidance and feedback from team members
Help standardize reporting structures, KPI frameworks, and data product design
Identify opportunities to improve analytical approaches, reporting processes, and data quality
Collaborate on team initiatives exploring new tools, technologies, and analytical approaches (e.g., GenAI-enabled analytics, automation)
Support continuous improvement through documentation, process enhancements, and adoption of best practices


Who You Are

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in reporting and analytics and contributes accurate, consistent outputs. You’re intellectually curious about data and how it drives business decisions, motivated to solve problems, and excited to continue developing your technical, analytical, and communication skills in a fast paced, collaborative environment. You take ownership of your work, actively seek learning opportunities through hands on experience, feedback, and mentorship, and contribute thoughtfully to team initiatives. You enjoy working with modern analytics tools and are energized by the opportunity to support meaningful business outcomes while steadily expanding your impact over time.


Solid foundation in reporting, data analysis, and visualization, with experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports
Detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy, consistency, and alignment to defined metrics and business logic
Analytical thinker who connects data outputs to business context and supports actionable insights
Independently manages reporting and data-related tasks with guidance as needed
Organized and able to manage multiple priorities effectively
Identifies issues, asks clarifying questions, and progresses work to completion
Collaborates effectively with team members and stakeholders to deliver consistent outputs
Experience working with data tools across reporting, data management, and visualization
Continues to build skills in data modeling and scalable reporting approaches
Works in evolving problem spaces using structured, data-driven approaches


What You've Accomplished


Brought new innovative ideas and approaches to looking at data and reports that led to groundbreaking new insights.
Taken complex data/information and make it simple, scalable, and actionable that led to measurable business impact.
Established strong stakeholder relationships and provided support to ensure success.
Have turned data into trusted information used to drive decisions and actions.
Identified process gaps or areas for optimization while also helping drive it from design to completion.


Pega Offers You


Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
Continuous learning and development opportunities
An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
Experience rapid professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex business challenges
Opportunities to take ownership of significant projects that directly impact business outcomes
Contribute to shaping the future of our analytics capabilities
Remote work options
Flexible PTO policy
Culture that celebrates innovation and continuous learning


Additional Information

Base salary range for this role is 71,300 - 106,600 USD annually. This role may also be eligible for annual bonus OR commission, as well as benefits and other incentives.

The final compensation will be determined during the offer process based on the candidate's education, experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as market conditions and may vary from the posted range. We will share an information on benefits, bonus/commission, and other pay components for this role at the relevant recruitment stage.

Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.

You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.

What You’ll Do


Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).
Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.
Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.
4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.
Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.
Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.
Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.
Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.
Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in life science industry


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
The Clinical Data Analyst (CDA) is a mid-level individual contributor role that supports the Data Sciences department in identifying requirements and building solutions towards enhancing clinical study data reporting and analytics capabilities.  This role will support in the development of advanced analytical solutions, better supporting internal and external stakeholders needs in summarizing clinical study data. This role will also enable operational quality and efficiency through the generation and analysis of departmental operational and performance metrics.




 




Reporting Standards Management


Lead the creation & development of a standard library of reporting and/or analysis solutions (report, dashboard, visualization, or other) for Data Sciences and other stakeholders


Gather requirements from a cross-functional group to a particular study question or operational activity


Build & configure solution to meet the requirements


Lead validation activities to prepare reporting solutions for release/usage


Gather (as needed) and collaborate with volunteer stakeholder group to support validation activities


Contribute to the Data Standards Governance Committee (DSGC) for the management of standard reports


Maintain ongoing updates to standard report templates


Support training for the Data Sciences team of new standard reports/solutions







Study-Specific Reporting Deployment


Deploy standard reporting solutions for use on a study-specific basis


Create & develop ad hoc reporting and/or analysis solutions – report, dashboard, visualization, or other – as requested by study team members


Gather requirements from study team member(s) for ad hoc solutions


Build & configure ad hoc solutions to meet the requirements


Support report requestor in validation activities of study-specific ad hoc solutions to prepare for release/usage


Support long-term maintenance of study-specific solutions and contribute to investigating issues, as raised by study team members







Department Operational & Performance Analysis


Identify requirements with Data Sciences leaders to measure & monitor operational and performance metrics


Design, build, and maintain metrics governance within Data Sciences


Work with large data sets to analyze operational & study data and deliver reporting that outline areas for process & performance improvement/optimization (inefficiencies, inaccuracies, and other issues) to Data Sciences leadership







Technical Systems


Participate in the strategy, management and integration of data reporting systems that impact Data Sciences, including the assessment, integration, build of vendor systems and Alimentiv technologies


Act as a technical system subject matter expert; perform validation and testing of systems


Help gather and determine requirements for relevant technical systems, with cross-functional groups or other Business/Process analysts. Work closely with other technical roles (Data Management, Database Programming, Statistics, Enterprise Analyses, etc.) to drive data governance and excellence


Assess ways to further leverage existing systems to optimize internal efficiencies and processes


Support Data Sciences contribution to a Data Warehouse, contributing to key decisions and strategy


While evaluating new projects or requests for enhancements, help determine the project cost, timeline, goals and feasibility and then support the project through completion







Qualifications


Minimum of a Bachelor's degree + 4-6 years of related experience


Strong analytical skills


Visual design and aesthetic sense to produce appealing and intuitive outputs


Proficiency with data visualization tools (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc)


Skilled data storyteller to communicate complex information in clear and effective manner


Strong collaborator


Preference to certificate in data analysis, data visualizations, or technical solutions (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.)


Preference to prior Clinical Research and/or Clinical Data Management experience







Working Condition


Home-based

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do.

Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of!

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!




Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.




Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!

Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000




Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
The Senior Data Analyst will help build trusted Finance data products and expand self-service analytics across FP&A. Working within the enterprise architecture and standards established by Shared Data Services, this role will translate Finance needs into scalable data solutions, validate and operationalize delivered assets, and directly build data models, transformations, pipelines, and dashboards when needed.

This is a highly technical individual-contributor role combining hands-on SQL and Python development, advanced analytics, data quality, business intelligence, and stakeholder partnership. The role will help Finance move from manual and fragmented analysis toward reusable data products that support driver-based forecasting, portfolio performance analysis, ad hoc decision support, and executive reporting.

Primary Responsibilities

Build Trusted Finance Data Products


Build, enhance, and maintain Finance tables, views, transformations, pipelines, and analytical models within established enterprise architecture, security, development, and governance standards.
Develop reusable data products supporting bookings, customers, billing, revenue, operational activity, and portfolio performance.
Use SQL and Python to automate data preparation, validation, and analytical workflows, and convert repeatable analyses into scalable assets.
Apply appropriate source control, testing, deployment, monitoring, and documentation practices to Finance data products.


Partner, Validate, and Operationalize


Translate FP&A and Portfolio Analytics needs into clear source requirements, data grain, business rules, transformation logic, quality controls, and acceptance criteria.
Own Finance requirements, prioritization, validation, and acceptance for data products delivered in partnership with onshore and offshore Shared Data Services teams.
Reconcile outputs to source systems, financial reporting, operational reporting, and approved methodologies; identify and resolve data quality issues, logic gaps, hierarchy problems, and incomplete coverage.
Maintain documentation for metric definitions, data lineage, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations, and coordinate issue resolution through Finance sign-off.


Deliver Advanced Analytics and Self-Service


Use SQL, Python, and appropriate analytical methods to solve complex customer, revenue, pricing, forecasting, portfolio, and operational questions.
Build semantic models, dashboards, and analytical tools using Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform.
Enable FP&A users to independently answer recurring business questions with trusted data, reducing manual extracts, spreadsheet-based preparation, and one-off reporting.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, documentation, and analytical productivity while validating outputs and protecting confidential data.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, analytical, Finance, or business discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex data and analytical solutions. Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting experience is helpful but not required.


Required Qualifications


Advanced SQL and strong dimensional and analytical data-modeling skills.
Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and advanced analytics.
Experience developing or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse environment.
Experience with data reconciliation, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and documentation.
Experience developing semantic models, dashboards, or business intelligence solutions.
Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable analytical and technical solutions.
Familiarity with source control, testing, deployment, and production support practices.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services, including lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, or related analytical workloads.
Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and DAX.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, or production support.
Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, commercial analytics, or executive reporting.
Familiarity with forecasting, customer analytics, revenue analytics, or portfolio analytics.
Experience working with centralized or shared enterprise data teams.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to execute independently.
Consultative approach and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Strong attention to data accuracy, controls, validation, and methodological consistency.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deliverables with clear follow-through.
Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action and iterative delivery.
Ability to learn new technologies, data sources, and business concepts quickly.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.EEO/AA/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Vets.

Title: HR Platform Data Analyst - WORKDAY HCM
Description:
To meet the challenges of the university’s continued growth and expansion, the HR Platforms (HRIT) team is looking for a qualified candidate who will contribute to the support and data analytics of Workday HCM.




***HYBRID _Required to be ON CAMPUS in BOSTON Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri (Wed is remote).




The HR Platforms (HRIT) Reporting & Data Analyst serves as a key data and reporting resource within HR Platforms, partnering with HR functional areas, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and deliver accurate, meaningful workforce data and analytics.




This role requires a strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, particularly within the complexities of a decentralized higher education environment with diverse employee populations, organizational structures, and business practices.




The Reporting & Data Analyst translates business needs into effective reporting and analytical solutions, developing and maintaining Workday reports, SQL queries, and other data solutions. The role analyzes complex datasets to identify trends, discrepancies, anomalies, and data integrity issues; investigates root causes; and provides insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.




This position also partners closely with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional teams to test, validate, and resolve data and reporting issues.




Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, expert proficiency in Excel, proficiency in SQL, attention to detail, and a naturally curious mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable asking questions, challenging data that does not appear correct, investigating complex issues, and translating analytical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences. The role requires sound judgment, initiative, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality and the highest standards of data integrity.




Key responsibilities include:

· Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and translate data needs into accurate, sustainable reporting and analytical solutions.

· Develop, maintain, and enhance reports and queries using Workday HCM/Payroll, Prism, SQL, Excel, and other reporting and analytical tools.

· Analyze and reconcile complex HR and Payroll datasets to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data integrity issues and investigate root causes.

· Collaborate with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional partners on requirements, testing, validation, system changes, and resolution of data and reporting issues.




To support the University's essential services and business operations, this position may occasionally be required to work outside of regular business hours, including during critical system activities, reporting deadlines, or other periods of operational need.




Minimum Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Human Resources, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
3–5 years of progressive experience in HR data analytics, HR systems, reporting, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing complex HR and payroll data.
Strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, including the ability to understand how transactions, business processes, organizational structures, compensation, time, absence, payroll, and employee lifecycle events impact downstream data and reporting.
Experience with Workday reporting across HCM and Payroll, including developing, maintaining, interpreting, and troubleshooting reports and identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and effectiveness.
Higher education HR and Payroll experience is strongly preferred, with an understanding of the unique organizational structures, academic populations, employee types, appointments, positions, grants/funding, faculty/staff populations, and other complexities common to higher education.

Title: Secondary Schools Analyst (Anticipated Vacancy) (SY26-27)
Description:
This position is an anticipated vacancy. It is expected to be vacant by 09/04/2026. However, the current incumbent has a right to rescind their retirement, leave, or resignation up until the day of the expected vacancy date. Your hire will not be confirmed until the position is vacated, and you may start the year as a Long-Term Substitute if the position does not become vacant by the start of the school year.

REPORTS TO: Director of Analytics

Boston Public Schools is seeking to fill the position of Secondary Schools Analyst in the Office of Data and Accountability (ODA). The Secondary Schools Analyst will work to establish district-wide systems and processes to track student access, participation, progress through and completion of high-quality career pathways that prepare students for success after graduation. Career pathways in BPS include but are not limited to Chapter 74 Career and Technical Education (CTE) programs, Early College pathways, and Innovation pathways. This position will involve a high level of coordination with internal BPS departments as well as external community partners,including, but not limited to, Edvestors, the Boston Private Industry Council and community colleges.

The Secondary Schools Analyst will create dashboards, complete standard reporting, and conduct strategic analyses related to career pathways and equitable access to these opportunities within BPS, using data including but not limited to participation in CTE, Early College or Innovation pathways, attainment of industry-recognized credentials, and postsecondary outcomes. Working in partnership with the ODA and Office of College, Career, and Life Readiness (CCLR), the analyst will also conduct analyses and advance strategic initiatives, using data including but not limited to standardized test scores (MCAS, AP, SAT, etc), attendance, coursework, out-of-school time programs, and post-secondary experiences. As a member of a highly collaborative group, and given the time-sensitive nature of many of these analyses, the Secondary Schools Analyst can expect to rely on the experience of other analysts within ODA, and will be expected in turn to support the work of colleagues on related projects.

RESPONSIBILITIES:


Establish district-wide systems and processes to track student access, participation and progress through career pathways:
Conduct a needs assessment to understand the current landscape of available data related to career pathways in BPS
Create and coordinate a cross-department team to:
map out current career and planned career pathways in BPS, and
develop systems and processes to track access, participation, progress through and completion of these pathways
Develop process to monitor, track and report pathway students completion of aligned college-level coursework (Dual Enrollment, Advanced Placement, International Baccalaureate)
Utilize user-centered design principles to understand pain points and opportunities for improvement of data access and use across all stakeholders
Develop an annual process to gather student and parent perspectives on access to career and academic planning and career pathways across grades 6-12
Manage the administration and reporting of the annual Senior Exit Survey, a tool used by the district and community partners to understand student perceptions around high school experience and preparation for post-secondary plans.
Develop and support the implementation of a data-driven understanding of career pathways across BPS:
Work with the Office of College, Career, and Life Readiness and the Office of Data and Accountability to identify areas for analysis related to career pathways and CCLR initiatives
Develop dashboards using PowerBI and ad-hoc standardized reports to increase access to key performance indicators and related data
Work with the Office of College, Career, and Life Readiness to fulfill all state and grant reporting requirements related to CTE, including identifying opportunities to implement process efficiencies
Fulfill career pathways- and CCLR-related data requests from internal and external members of the BPS community.
Perform various analyses on student-level, school-level, and district-level career pathways and provide relevant policy recommendations based on analyses.
Generate reports and deliver findings for both technical and non-technical audiences based on the results of analyses.
Expand the capacity of internal BPS departments, schools, and external community partners to access and effectively use career pathways and CCLR data
Serve as a member of the data working group of the New Skills Ready Network, a cross-sector initiative focused on increasing equitable access to career pathways.
Map data flows within organizations and between organizations at the secondary and postsecondary level to coordinate the shared data systems and build capacity/provide the resources needed for accurate and complete data collection and analysis.
Monitor and provide monthly aggregate school-based reports on CCLR milestone completion utilizing data from district and state systems.
Develop a professional development model for school counselors specific to current data systems and use of CCLR data within school-based intervention teams.
Provide technical assistance to school staff, central staff and external community partners regarding career pathways data needs and analyses.
Support student privacy regulations as mandated by FERPA, HIPAA, IDEA, MA DESE, City of Boston, and BPS; facilitate the execution of data sharing agreements where applicable
Perform other relevant duties in the Office of Data and Accountability and Office of College, Career, and Life Readiness as needed.


QUALIFICATIONS - REQUIRED:


Bachelor’s Degree in related field
Minimum of 2 years of data analysis experience, preferably in K – 12 education.
Strong analytic and data systems management skills, as well as extremely strong attention to detail.
Proficiency and/or expertise with statistical analysis software and programming languages (preferably STATA, R, SQL)
Enthusiasm for working on technical projects with a diverse team to completion.
Excellent time management skills, experience balancing competing priorities, and prioritizing resources.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Strong customer service focus.
Strong problem-solving skills.
The ability to explain complex analytical concepts in clear and concise terms.
The ability to react to requests with both flexibility and firmness (and the ability to distinguish when to use which skill).
Ability to communicate with diverse audiences and experience with Boston, its neighborhoods and schools.
A deeply held and unyielding belief in the overarching mission of public education and BPS’ role as an anti-racist organization.
Current authorization to work in the United States - Candidates must have such authorization by their first day of employment


QUALIFICATIONS - PREFERRED:


Master’s Degree
Experience collaborating across departmental lines
Experience with post-secondary and workforce readiness programs
Knowledge of the Ed-Fi data standard


TERMS: Managerial, C42. City of Boston residency is required.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0247289

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to the Navy to understand their data and support Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst embedded with a DOW client, you’ll work closely with our customers to understand their data questions and then dig into their data-rich environments and tools to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means by developing decision-making support visualization products and dashboards to help translate data into recommendations. You will use automation tools and scripts to streamline data processing and reporting.

What You'll Work On:


Provide clear, timely data analysis and trend insights for leadership in a fast paced environment and preparing written analysis.
Analyze data across various subject areas to develop a complete data picture for non-technical leadership and clients.
Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data is accessible and organized to support analysis, trend forecasting and alerting needs.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, and analysis of large data sets.
Establish quantitative/qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive decision-making.
Create visualizations and dashboards, such as graphs, tables, and maps, across multiple platforms to communicate findings effectively.
Produce recurring and rapid-turnaround reports and analysis, including responses to high-priority leadership and congressional requests, across multiple office branches to ensure a holistic understanding and facilitate informed decision-making.
Engage directly with clients to understand their evolving needs, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations. Adapt to client feedback and requests, fostering strong professional relationships and supporting informed decision-making at all organizational levels.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


3+ years of experience in data analysis or data visualization
Experience in quantitative data analysis, performance measurement, data cleansing, metrics evaluation, and applied research
Experience executing projects and tasks independently, including large-scale initiatives
Experience leading discussions about data products, sources, and projects with executive leadership
Ability to identify and analyze data sets to meet customer requirements and translate complex findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences
Ability to be organized, multi-task, and respond quickly to urgent requests
Ability to work closely with executive leadership on large data projects and communicate effectively via email and phone
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Law, Engineering, Social Sciences, Physical Science, Applied Science, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or Management



Nice If You Have:


3+ years of experience with data analysis or data visualization with Power BI, Excel, or Tableau preferred
Experience with data querying and manipulation using SQL or similar tools



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Modernization Data Analyst to support the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO). Come Join our growing team today!

We are seeking a skilled Modernization Data Analyst to support DoW CIO through their IT Modernization effort. This IT transformation is foundational to building a more lethal and ready Joint Force capable of operating in contested environments, which is essential for facing and deterring current and future threats. We encourage you to apply!

This position requires a SECRET level security clearance and will work onsite in Arlington, VA.

LEVEL 2 - $73,025 - $104,321

LEVEL 3 - $94,520 - $135,028

Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple legacy and modernized systems to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization.

Support data integration activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Department of War (DoW) data governance standards.
Contribute to the development of data quality metrics and automated validation processes.

LEVEL 2 - 3 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 1 year relevant experience with Masters in related field.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise manner.

May require working in an office, industrial, shipboard, or laboratory environment. Capable of climbing ladders and tolerating confined spaces and extreme temperature variances.

Description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

What We're Proud Of


2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing
2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology

Title: Federal Data Analyst

Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality

Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K
